name: toChart_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toChart_refl (P : IPFunctor.{uI, uJ, uA₁, uB₁} I J) :
    (refl P).toChart = Chart.id P

name: toChart_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toChart_trans (e₁ : P ≃ₚ Q) (e₂ : Q ≃ₚ R) :
    (e₁.trans e₂).toChart = Chart.comp e₂.toChart e₁.toChart

name: forward_equivB_roundtrip
statement:
private theorem forward_equivB_roundtrip (e : P ≃ₚ Q) (j : J) (a : P.A j)
    (b : P.B j a) :
    e.symm.equivB j (e.equivA j a) (e.equivB j a b) =
      _root_.cast
        (congrArg (P.B j) ((e.equivA j).symm_apply_apply a).symm) b
proof:
:= by
  change
    (((_root_.Equiv.cast _).trans
      (e.equivB j ((e.equivA j).symm (e.equivA j a))).symm) (e.equivB j a b)) = _
  simp only [_root_.Equiv.trans_apply]
  exact equivB_symm_apply_of_eq e j
    (a := (e.equivA j).symm (e.equivA j a)) (a' := a)
    (ha := (e.equivA j).apply_symm_apply _) (b := b)

name: reverse_equivB_roundtrip
statement:
private theorem reverse_equivB_roundtrip (e : P ≃ₚ Q) (j : J) (a : Q.A j)
    (b : Q.B j a) :
    e.equivB j ((e.equivA j).symm a) (e.symm.equivB j a b) =
      _root_.cast
        (congrArg (Q.B j) ((e.equivA j).apply_symm_apply a).symm) b
proof:
:= by
  change
    (e.equivB j ((e.equivA j).symm a))
      (((_root_.Equiv.cast _).trans
        (e.equivB j ((e.equivA j).symm a)).symm) b) = _
  simp [_root_.Equiv.trans_apply]

name: eqRec_id_apply_codomain
statement:
private theorem eqRec_id_apply_codomain
    {A : Sort*} {B : A → Sort*} {a₀ a₁ : A}
    (h : a₀ = a₁) (x : B a₀) :
    Eq.rec (motive := fun a _ => B a₀ → B a) id h x =
      _root_.cast (congrArg B h) x

name: symm_toChart_comp_toChart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_toChart_comp_toChart (e : P ≃ₚ Q) :
    Chart.comp e.symm.toChart e.toChart = Chart.id P
proof:
:= by
  refine Chart.ext _ _ (fun j a => by
    change (e.symm.equivA j) (e.equivA j a) = a
    exact (e.equivA j).symm_apply_apply a) ?_
  intro j a
  funext b
  simp only [Chart.comp, Chart.id, toChart, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [forward_equivB_roundtrip]
  exact (eqRec_id_apply_codomain ((e.equivA j).symm_apply_apply a).symm b).symm

name: toChart_comp_symm_toChart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toChart_comp_symm_toChart (e : P ≃ₚ Q) :
    Chart.comp e.toChart e.symm.toChart = Chart.id Q
proof:
:= by
  refine Chart.ext _ _ (fun j a => by
    change (e.equivA j) (e.symm.equivA j a) = a
    exact (e.equivA j).apply_symm_apply a) ?_
  intro j a
  funext b
  simp only [Chart.comp, Chart.id, toChart, Function.comp_apply]
  change e.equivB j ((e.equivA j).symm a) (e.symm.equivB j a b) = _
  rw [reverse_equivB_roundtrip]
  exact (eqRec_id_apply_codomain ((e.equivA j).apply_symm_apply a).symm b).symm

name: toChartEquiv_toChart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toChartEquiv_toChart (e : P ≃ₚ Q) : e.toChartEquiv.toChart = e.toChart

theorem toChartEquiv_invChart (e : P ≃ₚ Q) :

name: ext
statement:
@[ext (iff := false)]
theorem ext {P : IPFunctor.{uI, uJ, uA₁, uB₁} I J}
    {Q : IPFunctor.{uI, uJ, uA₂, uB₂} I J} (c₁ c₂ : Chart P Q)
    (hA : ∀ j a, c₁.toFunA j a = c₂.toFunA j a)
    (hB : ∀ j a, c₁.toFunB j a = (hA j a) ▸ c₂.toFunB j a) : c₁ = c₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases c₁ with ⟨toFunA₁, toFunB₁, src_eq₁⟩
  rcases c₂ with ⟨toFunA₂, toFunB₂, src_eq₂⟩
  have h : toFunA₁ = toFunA₂ := funext fun j => funext (hA j)
  subst h
  have h' : toFunB₁ = toFunB₂ := by
    funext j a
    simpa using hB j a
  subst h'
  rfl

name: allOutputs_postCond_and
statement:
theorem allOutputs_postCond_and {α : Type u} (x : m α)
    (Q₁ Q₂ : PostCond α .pure) :
    AllOutputs (fun a => ((Q₁.and Q₂).1 a).down) x ↔
      AllOutputs (fun a => (Q₁.1 a).down) x ∧ AllOutputs (fun a => (Q₂.1 a).down) x
proof:
:= by

name: erasesTo_of_map_eq

proof:

name: head_tails_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_tails_eq (s : NonEmptyList α) : (tails s).head = s

name: map_map

name: filterMap_fromList
statement:
theorem filterMap_fromList?_tails_map (f : α → β) (l : List α) :
    List.map (fun nel : NonEmptyList α => f nel.head)
      (List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails l)) = List.map f l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih => simp [List.tails, fromList?, ih]

name: filterMap_fromList
statement:
theorem filterMap_fromList?_tails_head (l : List α) :
    List.map (fun nel : NonEmptyList α => nel.head)
      (List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails l)) = l
proof:
:= by
  simpa using filterMap_fromList?_tails_map id l

name: filterMap_fromList
statement:
theorem filterMap_fromList?_tails_map_list (f : α → β) (l : List α) :
    List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails (List.map f l)) =
    List.map (map f) (List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails l))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih => simp [List.tails, fromList?, map, ih]

name: tails_map
statement:
theorem tails_map (f : α → β) (nel : NonEmptyList α) :
    tails (map f nel) = map (map f) (tails nel)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, t⟩ := nel
  simp only [tails, map]; congr 1
  exact filterMap_fromList?_tails_map_list f t

name: filterMap_fromList
statement:
theorem filterMap_fromList?_tails_tails (l : List α) :
    List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails
      (List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails l))) =
    List.map tails (List.filterMap NonEmptyList.fromList? (List.tails l))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih => simp only [List.tails, List.filterMap, fromList?, List.map, tails, ih]

name: tails_tails
statement: theorem tails_tails (nel : NonEmptyList α) : tails (tails nel) = map tails (tails nel)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, t⟩ := nel
  simp only [tails, map]; congr 1
  exact filterMap_fromList?_tails_tails t

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (z : Zipper α) :
    map g (map f z) = map (g ∘ f) z

name: iterateLeft_map_extract
statement:
theorem iterateLeft_map_extract (ls : List α) (f : α) (rs : List α) :
    List.map Zipper.extract (iterateLeft ⟨ls, f, rs⟩) = ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing f rs with
  | nil => simp [iterateLeft]
  | cons l ls' ih => simp [iterateLeft, extract, ih]

name: iterateRight_map_extract
statement:
theorem iterateRight_map_extract (ls : List α) (f : α) (rs : List α) :
    List.map Zipper.extract (iterateRight ⟨ls, f, rs⟩) = rs
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing ls f with
  | nil => simp [iterateRight]
  | cons r rs' ih => simp [iterateRight, extract, ih]

name: iterateLeft_map
statement:
theorem iterateLeft_map (f : α → β) (ls : List α) (c : α) (rs : List α) :
    iterateLeft (map f ⟨ls, c, rs⟩) = List.map (map f) (iterateLeft ⟨ls, c, rs⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing c rs with
  | nil => simp [iterateLeft]
  | cons l ls' ih => simp only [map, iterateLeft, List.map]; exact congrArg _ (ih l (c :: rs))

name: iterateRight_map
statement:
theorem iterateRight_map (f : α → β) (ls : List α) (c : α) (rs : List α) :
    iterateRight (map f ⟨ls, c, rs⟩) = List.map (map f) (iterateRight ⟨ls, c, rs⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing ls c with
  | nil => simp [iterateRight]
  | cons r rs' ih => simp only [map, iterateRight, List.map]; exact congrArg _ (ih (c :: ls) r)

name: duplicate_map
statement:
theorem duplicate_map (f : α → β) (l : List α) (c : α) (r : List α) :
    duplicate (map f ⟨l, c, r⟩) = map (map f) (duplicate ⟨l, c, r⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [duplicate, map]
  congr 1
  · exact iterateLeft_map f l c r
  · exact iterateRight_map f l c r

name: iterateLeft_duplicate
statement:
theorem iterateLeft_duplicate (ls : List α) (c : α) (rs : List α) :
    iterateLeft ⟨iterateLeft ⟨ls, c, rs⟩, ⟨ls, c, rs⟩, iterateRight ⟨ls, c, rs⟩⟩ =
    List.map duplicate (iterateLeft ⟨ls, c, rs⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing c rs with
  | nil => simp [iterateLeft]
  | cons l ls' ih =>
    simp only [iterateLeft, List.map]
    congr 1
    · simp [duplicate, iterateRight]
    · convert ih l (c :: rs) using 2; simp [iterateRight]

name: iterateRight_duplicate
statement:
theorem iterateRight_duplicate (ls : List α) (c : α) (rs : List α) :
    iterateRight ⟨iterateLeft ⟨ls, c, rs⟩, ⟨ls, c, rs⟩, iterateRight ⟨ls, c, rs⟩⟩ =
    List.map duplicate (iterateRight ⟨ls, c, rs⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing ls c with
  | nil => simp [iterateRight]
  | cons r rs' ih =>
    simp only [iterateRight, List.map]
    congr 1
    · simp [duplicate, iterateLeft]
    · convert ih (c :: ls) r using 2; simp [iterateLeft]

name: duplicate_duplicate
statement:
theorem duplicate_duplicate (l : List α) (c : α) (r : List α) :
    duplicate (duplicate ⟨l, c, r⟩) = map duplicate (duplicate ⟨l, c, r⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [duplicate, map]
  congr 1
  · exact iterateLeft_duplicate l c r
  · exact iterateRight_duplicate l c r

name: duplicate_map'
statement:
theorem duplicate_map' (f : α → β) (z : Zipper α) :
    duplicate (map f z) = map (map f) (duplicate z)

name: duplicate_duplicate'
statement:
theorem duplicate_duplicate' (z : Zipper α) :

name: map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} {a b : Type u₃}
    (k : a → b) (map' : α → β → a) (fa : f α) (gb : g β) :
  k <$> (⟨map', fa, gb⟩ : Day f g a) = ⟨fun x y => k (map' x y), fa, gb⟩

name: comonad_id_map
statement: theorem comonad_id_map {α : Type u} (wa : w α) : Functor.map id wa = wa

name: comonad_comp_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem comonad_comp_map {α β γ : Type u} (f : β → γ) (g : α → β) (wa : w α) :
    Functor.map (f ∘ g) wa = Functor.map f (Functor.map g wa)

name: extract_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem extract_map {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (wa : w α) :
    extract (Functor.map f wa) = f (extract wa)

name: extract_duplicate_eq_id
statement: theorem extract_duplicate_eq_id : extract (duplicate wa) = wa

name: map_extract_duplicate_eq_id
statement: theorem map_extract_duplicate_eq_id : Functor.map extract (duplicate wa) = wa
proof:
:= by
  rw [duplicate, map_eq_extend_extract, extend_assoc]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, extract_extend, id_def]
  rw [extend_extract]

name: extend_eq_map_duplicate
statement:
theorem extend_eq_map_duplicate {β : Type u} (f : w α → β) :
    extend wa f = Functor.map f (duplicate wa)
proof:
:= by
  rw [duplicate, map_eq_extend_extract, extend_assoc]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, extract_extend, id_def]

name: duplicate_duplicate_eq_map_duplicate
statement:
theorem duplicate_duplicate_eq_map_duplicate :
    duplicate (duplicate wa) = Functor.map duplicate (duplicate wa)
proof:
:= by
  have h_lhs : duplicate (duplicate wa) = extend wa duplicate := by
    rw [duplicate, duplicate, extend_assoc]
    simp only [id_def]
    rfl
  have h_rhs : Functor.map duplicate (duplicate wa) = extend wa duplicate := by
    rw [duplicate, map_eq_extend_extract, extend_assoc]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, extract_extend, id_def]
  rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]

name: append
proof:
:= by
  induction first with
  | nil _ => exact second
  | cons head _ ih => exact .cons head (ih second)

name: nil_mem_traces
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_mem_traces (s : L.State) : [] ∈ L.traces s

name: weakTrace_iff_mTr
statement:
theorem weakTrace_iff_mTr {s t : L.State} {observations : List Obs} :
    L.WeakTrace s observations t ↔
      L.toLts.saturate.MTr s (observations.map some) t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | nil _ => exact .refl
    | cons head _ ih => exact .stepL (L.sTr_toLts_iff.mpr head) ih
  · intro h
    induction observations generalizing s with
    | nil => cases h; exact .nil _
    | cons obs rest ih =>
        rcases h with _ | ⟨hhead, htail⟩
        exact .cons (L.sTr_toLts_iff.mp hhead) (ih htail)

name: mem_traces_iff_mem_toLts
statement:
theorem mem_traces_iff_mem_toLts {s : L.State} {observations : List Obs} :
    observations ∈ L.traces s ↔
      observations.map some ∈ L.toLts.saturate.traces s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨t, h⟩ => ⟨t, L.weakTrace_iff_mTr.mp h⟩, fun ⟨t, h⟩ => ⟨t, L.weakTrace_iff_mTr.mpr h⟩⟩

name: weakTrace
proof:
:= by
  induction trace generalizing s₂ with
  | nil s => exact ⟨s₂, .nil s₂, hrel⟩
  | cons head _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨middle₂, head₂, hmiddle⟩ :=
        simulation.weakStep hrel head
      obtain ⟨t₂, tail₂, ht⟩ := ih hmiddle
      exact ⟨t₂, .cons head₂ tail₂, ht⟩

name: traces_subset
proof:
:= by
  rintro observations ⟨t₁, trace⟩
  obtain ⟨t₂, trace₂, _⟩ := simulation.weakTrace hrel trace
  exact ⟨t₂, trace₂⟩

name: traces_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext observations
  exact ⟨fun h => IsWeakSimulation.traces_subset bisimulation.forward hrel h,
    fun h => IsWeakSimulation.traces_subset bisimulation.backward hrel h⟩

name: mem_support
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_support [MonadAttach m] {x : m α} {a : α} :
    a ∈ support x ↔ CanReturn x a

name: support_eq_empty_iff
statement:
theorem support_eq_empty_iff [MonadAttach m] {x : m α} :
    support x = ∅ ↔ ∀ a, ¬ CanReturn x a

name: support_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem support_nonempty_iff [MonadAttach m] {x : m α} :
    (support x).Nonempty ↔ ∃ a, CanReturn x a

name: not_mem_support_iff
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_iff [MonadAttach m] {x : m α} {a : α} :
    a ∉ support x ↔ ¬ CanReturn x a

name: support_ite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_ite [MonadAttach m] (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (x y : m α) :
    support (if c then x else y) = if c then support x else support y

name: support_dite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_dite [MonadAttach m] (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (x : c → m α) (y : ¬ c → m α) :
    support (if h : c then x h else y h) = if h : c then support (x h) else support (y h)

name: support_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_pure (b : α) : support (pure b : m α) = {b}
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  refine ⟨fun h => (LawfulMonadAttach.eq_of_canReturn_pure h).symm, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
  subst h
  exact ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_pure c

name: support_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_bind (x : m α) (f : α → m β) :
    support (x >>= f) = ⋃ a ∈ support x, support (f a)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ => ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_bind ha hb⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := LawfulMonadAttach.canReturn_bind_imp' h
  exact ⟨a, ha, hb⟩

name: mem_support_pure
statement: theorem mem_support_pure {a b : α} : a ∈ support (pure b : m α) ↔ a = b

name: canReturn_pure_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem canReturn_pure_iff {a b : α} : CanReturn (pure b : m α) a ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (LawfulMonadAttach.eq_of_canReturn_pure h).symm,
    fun h => by subst h; exact ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_pure _⟩

name: canReturn_bind_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem canReturn_bind_iff {x : m α} {f : α → m β} {b : β} :
    CanReturn (x >>= f) b ↔ ∃ a, CanReturn x a ∧ CanReturn (f a) b
proof:
:=
  ⟨LawfulMonadAttach.canReturn_bind_imp',
    fun ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ => ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_bind ha hb⟩

name: canReturn_map_iff
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem canReturn_map_iff {g : α → β} {x : m α} {b : β} :
    CanReturn (g <$> x) b ↔ ∃ a, CanReturn x a ∧ g a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨LawfulMonadAttach.canReturn_map_imp',
    fun ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ => hab ▸ by
      rw [← bind_pure_comp]
      exact ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_bind ha (ExactMonadAttach.canReturn_pure _)⟩

name: mem_support_bind
statement:
theorem mem_support_bind {x : m α} {f : α → m β} {b : β} :
    b ∈ support (x >>= f) ↔ ∃ a ∈ support x, b ∈ support (f a)

name: support_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_map (g : α → β) (x : m α) : support (g <$> x) = g '' support x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure_comp, support_bind]
  ext b
  simp [eq_comm]

name: support_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_seq (f : m (α → β)) (x : m α) :
    support (f <*> x) = ⋃ g ∈ support f, g '' support x

name: allOutputs_iff_forall_support
statement:
theorem allOutputs_iff_forall_support (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    AllOutputs p x ↔ ∀ a ∈ support x, p a

name: someOutput_iff_exists_support
statement:
theorem someOutput_iff_exists_support (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    SomeOutput p x ↔ ∃ a ∈ support x, p a

name: noOutput_iff_forall_support
statement:
theorem noOutput_iff_forall_support (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    NoOutput p x ↔ ∀ a ∈ support x, ¬ p a

name: allOutputs_iff_forall_canReturn
statement:
theorem allOutputs_iff_forall_canReturn (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    AllOutputs p x ↔ ∀ a, CanReturn x a → p a

name: support_eq_setOf_someOutput
statement:
theorem support_eq_setOf_someOutput (x : m α) :
    support x = {a | SomeOutput (· = a) x}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun a => ⟨fun ha => ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, fun ⟨_, hb, hba⟩ => hba ▸ hb⟩

name: someOutput_eq_iff_mem_support
statement:
theorem someOutput_eq_iff_mem_support (x : m α) (a : α) :
    SomeOutput (· = a) x ↔ a ∈ support x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, hb, hba⟩ => hba ▸ hb, fun ha => ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩

name: not_someOutput_iff_noOutput
statement:
theorem not_someOutput_iff_noOutput (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    ¬ SomeOutput p x ↔ NoOutput p x

name: allOutputs_and
statement:
theorem allOutputs_and (p q : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    AllOutputs (fun a => p a ∧ q a) x ↔ AllOutputs p x ∧ AllOutputs q x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨fun a ha => (h a ha).1, fun a ha => (h a ha).2⟩,
    fun ⟨hp, hq⟩ a ha => ⟨hp a ha, hq a ha⟩⟩

name: allOutputs_mono
statement:
theorem allOutputs_mono {p q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, p a → q a) {x : m α}
    (hx : AllOutputs p x) : AllOutputs q x
proof:
:=
  fun a ha => h a (hx a ha)

name: someOutput_mono
statement:
theorem someOutput_mono {p q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, p a → q a) {x : m α}
    (hx : SomeOutput p x) : SomeOutput q x
proof:
:=
  hx.imp fun a ⟨ha, hpa⟩ => ⟨ha, h a hpa⟩

name: noOutput_mono
statement:
theorem noOutput_mono {p q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, q a → p a) {x : m α}
    (hx : NoOutput p x) : NoOutput q x
proof:
:=
  fun a ha hqa => hx a ha (h a hqa)

name: not_allOutputs_iff
statement:
theorem not_allOutputs_iff (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    ¬ AllOutputs p x ↔ SomeOutput (fun a => ¬ p a) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AllOutputs, SomeOutput, not_forall]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => ⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩, fun ⟨a, ha, hna⟩ => ⟨a, by simp [ha, hna]⟩⟩

name: not_noOutput_iff
statement:
theorem not_noOutput_iff (p : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    ¬ NoOutput p x ↔ SomeOutput p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [NoOutput, not_allOutputs_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.imp fun _ ⟨ha, hp⟩ => ⟨ha, not_not.mp hp⟩,
    fun h => h.imp fun _ ⟨ha, hp⟩ => ⟨ha, not_not.mpr hp⟩⟩

name: someOutput_iff_not_noOutput
statement:

name: someOutput_or
statement:
theorem someOutput_or (p q : α → Prop) (x : m α) :
    SomeOutput (fun a => p a ∨ q a) x ↔ SomeOutput p x ∨ SomeOutput q x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hp | hq⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨a, ha, hp⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, hq⟩
  · rintro (⟨a, ha, hp⟩ | ⟨a, ha, hq⟩)
    · exact ⟨a, ha, Or.inl hp⟩
    · exact ⟨a, ha, Or.inr hq⟩

name: allOutputs_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allOutputs_bind (p : β → Prop) (x : m α) (f : α → m β) :
    AllOutputs p (x >>= f) ↔ ∀ a ∈ support x, AllOutputs p (f a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha b hb
    exact h b (mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩)
  · intro h b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hb
    exact h a ha b hb

name: someOutput_bind

    SomeOutput p (x >>= f) ↔ ∃ a ∈ support x, SomeOutput p (f a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hb
    exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hp⟩
    exact ⟨b, mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩, hp⟩

name: wp_iff_forall_support
statement:
theorem wp_iff_forall_support (x : m α) (post : α → Prop) :
    MAlgOrdered.wp (l := Prop) x post ↔ ∀ a ∈ support x, post a
proof:
:= by
  change AllOutputs id (x >>= fun a => pure (post a)) ↔ _
  rw [allOutputs_bind]
  exact ⟨fun h a ha => (allOutputs_pure id (post a)).mp (h a ha),
    fun h a ha => (allOutputs_pure id (post a)).mpr (h a ha)⟩

name: wp_iff_allOutputs
statement:

name: triple_top_iff_allOutputs
statement:
theorem triple_top_iff_allOutputs (x : m α) (post : α → Prop) :
    MAlgOrdered.Triple (l := Prop) ⊤ x post ↔ AllOutputs post x
proof:
:= by
  rw [MAlgOrdered.Triple, top_le_iff, ← wp_iff_allOutputs x post]
  exact ⟨fun h => h ▸ trivial, fun h => eq_true h⟩

name: triple_top_not_iff_noOutput
statement:
theorem triple_top_not_iff_noOutput (x : m α) (post : α → Prop) :
    MAlgOrdered.Triple (l := Prop) ⊤ x (fun a => ¬ post a) ↔ NoOutput post x
proof:
:=
  triple_top_iff_allOutputs x fun a => ¬ post a

name: wp_angelic_iff_exists_support
statement:
theorem wp_angelic_iff_exists_support (x : m α) (post : α → Prop) :
    MAlgOrdered.wp (l := Prop) x post ↔ ∃ a ∈ support x, post a
proof:
:= by
  change SomeOutput id (x >>= fun a => pure (post a)) ↔ _
  rw [someOutput_bind]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha, h⟩ => ⟨a, ha, (someOutput_pure id (post a)).mp h⟩,
    fun ⟨a, ha, h⟩ => ⟨a, ha, (someOutput_pure id (post a)).mpr h⟩⟩

name: wp_angelic_iff_someOutput

name: StateT.allOutputsFrom_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem StateT.allOutputsFrom_bind {σ : Type u} (s : σ) (p : β → σ → Prop)
    (x : StateT σ m α) (f : α → StateT σ m β) :
    StateT.AllOutputsFrom s p (x >>= f)
      ↔ ∀ q ∈ StateT.supportFrom s x, StateT.AllOutputsFrom q.2 p (f q.1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq a ha
    exact h a (by rw [StateT.supportFrom_bind]; exact Set.mem_biUnion hq ha)
  · intro h a ha
    rw [StateT.supportFrom_bind] at ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq, ha'⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp ha
    exact h q hq a ha'

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : FreeContT f m α}
    (h : ∀ (r : Type u) (handleEff : {x : Type z} → f x → ContT r m x)
      (handlePure : α → m r), x.run handleEff handlePure = y.run handleEff handlePure) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | mk x =>
    cases y with
    | mk y =>
      congr
      funext r handleEff handlePure
      exact h r handleEff handlePure

statement:

theorem FreeContM.toFreeM_pure (a : α) :
    FreeContM.toFreeM
        (FreeContT.pure a : FreeContM.{max (max y (z + 1)) w} f α) =

name: FreeContM.toFreeM_liftBind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FreeContM.toFreeM_liftBind {ι : Type z} (op : f ι)
    (next : ι → FreeContM.{max (max y (z + 1)) w} f α) :
    FreeContM.toFreeM (FreeContT.liftBind op next) =
      Cslib.FreeM.liftBind op fun result => FreeContM.toFreeM (next result)

name: Cslib.FreeM.toFreeM_toFreeContM
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cslib.FreeM.toFreeM_toFreeContM (x : Cslib.FreeM f α) :
    FreeContM.toFreeM (Cslib.FreeM.toFreeContM x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op next ih =>
      rw [← Cslib.FreeM.liftBind_eq]
      dsimp only [Cslib.FreeM.toFreeContM, FreeContM.toFreeM, FreeContT.liftBind]
      congr
      exact funext ih

name: wp_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wp_pure [LawfulMonad m] (x : α) (post : α → l) :

name: wp_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wp_bind [LawfulMonad m] (x : m α) (f : α → m β) (post : β → l) :
    wp (x >>= f) post = wp x (fun a => wp (f a) post)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wp
  rw [bind_assoc]
  exact μ_bind
    x
    (fun a => f a >>= fun b => pure (post b))
    (fun a => pure (MAlgOrdered.μ (f a >>= fun b => pure (post b))))
    (fun a => by
      simpa using
        (MAlgOrdered.μ_pure
          (m := m) (l := l) (x := MAlgOrdered.μ (f a >>= fun b => pure (post b)))).symm)

name: wp_mono
statement:
theorem wp_mono (x : m α) {post post' : α → l} (h : ∀ a, post a ≤ post' a) :
    wp x post ≤ wp x post'
proof:
:= by
  unfold wp
  exact MAlgOrdered.μ_bind_mono
    (f := fun a => pure (post a))
    (g := fun a => pure (post' a))
    (fun a => by simpa [MAlgOrdered.μ_pure] using h a)
    x

name: wp_map
statement:

theorem wp_map [LawfulMonad m] (f : α → β) (x : m α) (post : β → l) :
    wp (f <$> x) post = wp x (fun a => post (f a))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Functor.map, bind_pure_comp] using
    (wp_bind (m := m) (l := l) x (fun a => pure (f a)) post)

name: wp_seq
statement:

theorem wp_seq [LawfulMonad m] (f : m (α → β)) (x : m α) (post : β → l) :
    wp (f <*> x) post = wp f (fun g => wp x (fun a => post (g a)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [seq_eq_bind_map, wp_bind]
  congr
  funext g
  simp [wp_map]

name: triple_conseq
proof:
:= by

name: triple_pure

proof:

name: wpExc_def
statement:
private theorem wpExc_def (x : ExceptT ε m α) (postOk : α → l) (postErr : ε → l) :
    wpExc x postOk postErr = MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) x.run (excPost postOk postErr)

name: wpExc_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wpExc_pure (a : α) (postOk : α → l) (postErr : ε → l) :
    wpExc (pure a : ExceptT ε m α) postOk postErr = postOk a

name: wpExc_throw
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wpExc_throw (e : ε) (postOk : α → l) (postErr : ε → l) :
    wpExc (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e)) : ExceptT ε m α) postOk postErr = postErr e
proof:
:= by
  change MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) (pure (Except.error e)) (excPost postOk postErr) = _
  rw [wp_pure]
  rfl

name: wpExc_bind
statement:
theorem wpExc_bind (x : ExceptT ε m α) (f : α → ExceptT ε m β)
    (postOk : β → l) (postErr : ε → l) :
    wpExc (x >>= f) postOk postErr =
      wpExc x (fun a => wpExc (f a) postOk postErr) postErr
proof:
:= by
  rw [wpExc_def, wpExc_def, ExceptT.run_bind, wp_bind]
  congr 1
  funext ea
  cases ea with
  | ok a => rfl
  | error e =>
      rw [wp_pure]
      rfl

name: wpExc_tryCatch
statement:
theorem wpExc_tryCatch (x : ExceptT ε m α) (h : ε → ExceptT ε m α)
    (postOk : α → l) (postErr : ε → l) :
    wpExc (ExceptT.tryCatch x h) postOk postErr =
      wpExc x postOk (fun e => wpExc (h e) postOk postErr)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wpExc
  unfold ExceptT.tryCatch ExceptT.run ExceptT.mk
  rw [wp_bind]
  congr 1
  funext ea
  cases ea with
  | ok a => rw [wp_pure]
  | error e => rfl

name: wpExc_mono
statement:
theorem wpExc_mono (x : ExceptT ε m α)
    {postOk postOk' : α → l} {postErr postErr' : ε → l}
    (hOk : ∀ a, postOk a ≤ postOk' a) (hErr : ∀ e, postErr e ≤ postErr' e) :
    wpExc x postOk postErr ≤ wpExc x postOk' postErr'
proof:
:= by
  rw [wpExc_def, wpExc_def]
  apply wp_mono
  intro ea
  cases ea with
  | ok a => exact hOk a
  | error e => exact hErr e

name: wpOpt_def
statement:
private theorem wpOpt_def (x : OptionT m α) (postSome : α → l) (postNone : l) :
    wpOpt x postSome postNone = MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) x.run (optPost postSome postNone)

name: wpOpt_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wpOpt_pure (a : α) (postSome : α → l) (postNone : l) :
    wpOpt (pure a : OptionT m α) postSome postNone = postSome a
proof:
:= by
  change MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) (pure (some a)) (optPost postSome postNone) = _
  rw [wp_pure]

name: wpOpt_fail
statement:

    wpOpt (OptionT.mk (pure none) : OptionT m α) postSome postNone = postNone
proof:
:= by
  change MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) (pure none) (optPost postSome postNone) = _
  rw [wp_pure]

name: wpOpt_bind
statement:
theorem wpOpt_bind (x : OptionT m α) (f : α → OptionT m β)
    (postSome : β → l) (postNone : l) :
    wpOpt (x >>= f) postSome postNone =
      wpOpt x (fun a => wpOpt (f a) postSome postNone) postNone
proof:
:= by
  rw [wpOpt_def, wpOpt_def, OptionT.run_bind]
  change MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) (x.run >>= fun oa =>
      Option.elim oa (pure none) (fun a => (f a).run)) (optPost postSome postNone) = _
  rw [wp_bind]
  congr 1
  funext oa
  cases oa with
  | some a => rfl
  | none =>
      change MAlgOrdered.wp (m := m) (pure none) _ = _
      rw [wp_pure]
      rfl

name: wpOpt_mono
statement:
theorem wpOpt_mono (x : OptionT m α)
    {postSome postSome' : α → l} {postNone postNone' : l}
    (hSome : ∀ a, postSome a ≤ postSome' a) (hNone : postNone ≤ postNone') :
    wpOpt x postSome postNone ≤ wpOpt x postSome' postNone'
proof:
:= by
  rw [wpOpt_def, wpOpt_def]
  apply wp_mono
  intro oa
  cases oa with
  | some a => exact hSome a
  | none => exact hNone

name: strictBindStateTLeft
statement:
theorem strictBindStateTLeft [StrictBind m₁ m₂ l] (σ : Type u) :
    letI
proof:
:= stateTLeft (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) σ
    StrictBind (StateT σ m₁) m₂ (σ → l) := by
  let := stateTLeft (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) σ
  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }
  intro α β γ δ x y f g post
  funext s
  have h := StrictBind.rwp_bind (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l)
    (x := x.run s) (y := y) (f := fun xs => (f xs.1).run xs.2) (g := g)
    (post := fun zs d => post zs.1 d zs.2)
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

:= stateTRight (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) σ
    StrictBind m₁ (StateT σ m₂) (σ → l) := by

  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }

  funext s
  have h := StrictBind.rwp_bind (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l)
    (x := x) (y := y.run s) (f := f) (g := fun ys => (g ys.1).run ys.2)
    (post := fun c td => post c td.1 td.2)
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

    StrictBind (StateT σ₁ m₁) (StateT σ₂ m₂) (σ₁ → σ₂ → l) := by
  let := stateTBoth (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) σ₁ σ₂
  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }
  intro α β γ δ x y f g post
  funext s₁ s₂
  have h := StrictBind.rwp_bind (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l)

name: strictBindReaderTRight
statement:
theorem strictBindReaderTRight [StrictBind m₁ m₂ l] (ρ : Type u) :

proof:
:= readerTRight (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) ρ
    StrictBind m₁ (ReaderT ρ m₂) (ρ → l) := by
  let := readerTRight (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) ρ

  funext r
  have h := StrictBind.rwp_bind (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l)
    (x := x) (y := y.run r) (f := f) (g := fun b => (g b).run r)
    (post := fun c d => post c d r)
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

name: strictBindReaderTBoth
statement:
theorem strictBindReaderTBoth [StrictBind m₁ m₂ l] (ρ₁ ρ₂ : Type u) :
    letI
proof:
:= readerTBoth (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) ρ₁ ρ₂
    StrictBind (ReaderT ρ₁ m₁) (ReaderT ρ₂ m₂) (ρ₁ → ρ₂ → l) := by
  let := readerTBoth (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l) ρ₁ ρ₂
  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }
  intro α β γ δ x y f g post
  funext r₁ r₂
  have h := StrictBind.rwp_bind (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) (l := l)
    (x := x.run r₁) (y := y.run r₂)
    (f := fun a => (f a).run r₁) (g := fun b => (g b).run r₂)
    (post := fun c d => post c d r₁ r₂)
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

name: relWP_pure_left
statement:
theorem relWP_pure_left [Anchored m₁ m₂ l] (a : α) (y : m₂ β) (post : α → β → l) :
    RelWP (pure a : m₁ α) y post = MAlgOrdered.wp y (post a)

name: relWP_pure_right
statement:
theorem relWP_pure_right [Anchored m₁ m₂ l] (x : m₁ α) (b : β) (post : α → β → l) :
    RelWP x (pure b : m₂ β) post = MAlgOrdered.wp x (fun a => post a b)

name: rwpExc_def
statement:
theorem rwpExc_def (x : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) (y : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc x y post = MAlgRelOrdered.rwp (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) x.run y.run post

name: rwpExc_pure_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem rwpExc_pure_pure (a : α) (b : β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (pure a : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) (pure b : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post =
      post (Except.ok a) (Except.ok b)

name: rwpExc_throw_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem rwpExc_throw_pure (e : ε₁) (b : β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e)) : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α)
      (pure b : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post = post (Except.error e) (Except.ok b)

name: rwpExc_pure_throw
statement:
@[simp] theorem rwpExc_pure_throw (a : α) (e : ε₂)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (pure a : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α)
      (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e)) : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post =
      post (Except.ok a) (Except.error e)

name: rwpExc_throw_throw
statement:
@[simp] theorem rwpExc_throw_throw (e₁ : ε₁) (e₂ : ε₂)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e₁)) : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α)
      (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e₂)) : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post =
      post (Except.error e₁) (Except.error e₂)

name: rwpExc_mono
rwpExc_bind_le
statement:
theorem rwpExc_bind_le (x : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) (y : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β)
    (f : α → ExceptT ε₁ m₁ γ) (g : β → ExceptT ε₂ m₂ δ)
    (post : Except ε₁ γ → Except ε₂ δ → l) :
    rwpExc x y (fun ea eb =>
        rwpExc (ExceptT.mk (ExceptT.bindCont f ea))
          (ExceptT.mk (ExceptT.bindCont g eb)) post) ≤
      rwpExc (x >>= f) (y >>= g) post

name: rwpExc_pure_left
statement:
theorem rwpExc_pure_left (a : α) (y : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (pure a : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) y post =
      MAlgOrdered.wpExc y (fun b => post (Except.ok a) (Except.ok b))
        (fun e => post (Except.ok a) (Except.error e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rwpExc_def, ExceptT.run_pure, Anchored.rwp_pure_left]
  congr 1
  funext eb
  cases eb <;> rfl

name: rwpExc_pure_right
statement:
theorem rwpExc_pure_right (x : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) (b : β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc x (pure b : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post =
      MAlgOrdered.wpExc x (fun a => post (Except.ok a) (Except.ok b))
        (fun e => post (Except.error e) (Except.ok b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rwpExc_def, ExceptT.run_pure, Anchored.rwp_pure_right]
  congr 1
  funext ea
  cases ea <;> rfl

name: rwpExc_throw_left
statement:
theorem rwpExc_throw_left (e : ε₁) (y : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e)) : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) y post =
      MAlgOrdered.wpExc y (fun b => post (Except.error e) (Except.ok b))
        (fun e' => post (Except.error e) (Except.error e'))
proof:
:= by
  change MAlgRelOrdered.rwp (pure (Except.error e) : m₁ (Except ε₁ α)) y.run post = _
  rw [Anchored.rwp_pure_left]
  congr 1
  funext eb
  cases eb <;> rfl

name: rwpExc_throw_right
statement:
theorem rwpExc_throw_right (x : ExceptT ε₁ m₁ α) (e : ε₂)
    (post : Except ε₁ α → Except ε₂ β → l) :
    rwpExc x (ExceptT.mk (pure (Except.error e)) : ExceptT ε₂ m₂ β) post =
      MAlgOrdered.wpExc x (fun a => post (Except.ok a) (Except.error e))
        (fun e' => post (Except.error e') (Except.error e))
proof:
:= by
  change MAlgRelOrdered.rwp x.run (pure (Except.error e) : m₂ (Except ε₂ β)) post = _
  rw [Anchored.rwp_pure_right]
  congr 1
  funext ea
  cases ea <;> rfl

name: relWP_demonic_iff_forall_support
statement:
theorem relWP_demonic_iff_forall_support {α β : Type} (x : m₁ α) (y : m₂ β)
    (post : α → β → Prop) :
    RelWP x y post ↔ ∀ a ∈ support x, ∀ b ∈ support y, post a b

name: strictBindPropDemonic
statement: theorem strictBindPropDemonic : StrictBind m₁ m₂ Prop
proof:
:= by
  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }
  intro α β γ δ x y f g post
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro h c hc d hd
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hc⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hd⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hd
    exact h a ha b hb c hc d hd
  · intro h a ha b hb c hc d hd
    exact h c (mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨a, ha, hc⟩)
      d (mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨b, hb, hd⟩)

name: anchoredPropDemonic
statement: theorem anchoredPropDemonic : Anchored m₁ m₂ Prop
proof:
:= by
  refine { rwp_pure_left := ?_, rwp_pure_right := ?_ }
  · intro α β a y post
    apply propext
    change AllOutputs (fun a' => AllOutputs (post a') y) (pure a : m₁ α) ↔
      MAlgOrdered.wp y (post a)
    rw [allOutputs_pure, wp_iff_allOutputs]
  · intro α β x b post
    apply propext
    change AllOutputs (fun a => AllOutputs (post a) (pure b : m₂ β)) x ↔
      MAlgOrdered.wp x (fun a => post a b)
    rw [wp_iff_allOutputs]
    apply allOutputs_congr
    intro a
    exact allOutputs_pure (post a) b

name: relWP_angelic_iff_exists_support
statement:
theorem relWP_angelic_iff_exists_support {α β : Type} (x : m₁ α) (y : m₂ β)
    (post : α → β → Prop) :
    RelWP x y post ↔ ∃ a ∈ support x, ∃ b ∈ support y, post a b

name: strictBindPropAngelic
statement: theorem strictBindPropAngelic : StrictBind m₁ m₂ Prop
proof:
:= by
  refine { rwp_bind := ?_ }
  intro α β γ δ x y f g post
  apply propext
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, d, hd, hcd⟩
    exact ⟨c, mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨a, ha, hc⟩,
      d, mem_support_bind.mpr ⟨b, hb, hd⟩, hcd⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, d, hd, hcd⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hc⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hd⟩ := mem_support_bind.mp hd
    exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, d, hd, hcd⟩

name: anchoredPropAngelic
statement: theorem anchoredPropAngelic : Anchored m₁ m₂ Prop
proof:
:= by
  refine { rwp_pure_left := ?_, rwp_pure_right := ?_ }
  · intro α β a y post
    apply propext
    change SomeOutput (fun a' => SomeOutput (post a') y) (pure a : m₁ α) ↔
      MAlgOrdered.wp y (post a)
    rw [someOutput_pure, wp_angelic_iff_someOutput]
  · intro α β x b post
    apply propext
    change SomeOutput (fun a => SomeOutput (post a) (pure b : m₂ β)) x ↔
      MAlgOrdered.wp x (fun a => post a b)
    rw [wp_angelic_iff_someOutput]
    apply someOutput_congr
    intro a
    exact someOutput_pure (post a) b

name: _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat_eq_pure_compFlatPure
proof:
:= by
  let rec go
      (s₁ : TypeTree) (r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁)
      {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree}
      {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)}
      {Mid : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → Type u}
      {Output : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₁.append s₂) → Type u}
      (strat₁ : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal s₁ r₁ Mid)
      (f : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → Mid tr₁ →
        StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁)
          (fun tr₂ => Output (PFunctor.FreeM.Path.append s₁ s₂ tr₁ tr₂))) :
      StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat strat₁ (fun tr₁ mid => pure (f tr₁ mid)) =
        pure (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlatPure strat₁ f) := by
    match s₁, r₁ with
    | .done, r₁ =>
        cases r₁
        rfl
    | .node X rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ =>
        rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat.eq_2]
        congr 1
        apply bind_congr
        intro xc
        cases xc with
        | mk x next =>
            simp only [bind_pure_comp]
            have hgo := go (rest x) (rRest x)
              (s₂ := fun tr₁ => s₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩)
              (r₂ := fun tr₁ => r₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩)
              (Output := fun tr => Output ⟨x, tr⟩)
              next
              (fun tr₁ mid => f ⟨x, tr₁⟩ mid)
            exact (congrArg (fun z => Sigma.mk x <$> z) hgo).trans (map_pure _ _)
    | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ =>
        rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat.eq_3]
        congr 1
        funext x
        refine congrArg (fun k => strat₁ x >>= k) ?_
        funext next
        exact go (rest x) (rRest x)
          (s₂ := fun tr₁ => s₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩)
          (r₂ := fun tr₁ => r₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩)
          (Output := fun tr => Output ⟨x, tr⟩)
          next
          (fun tr₁ mid => f ⟨x, tr₁⟩ mid)
  exact go s₁ r₁ strat₁ f

name: _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat_splitPrefix
proof:
:= by
  let rec go
      (s₁ : TypeTree) (r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁)
      {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree}
      {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)}
      {Output : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₁.append s₂) → Type u}
      (strat : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
        (s₁.append s₂) (r₁.append r₂) Output) :
      StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix (s₂ := s₂) (r₁ := r₁) (r₂ := r₂) strat)
        (fun _ strat₂ => pure strat₂) = pure strat := by
    match s₁, r₁ with
    | .done, r₁ =>
        cases r₁
        rfl
    | .node X rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ =>
        rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat.eq_2,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix.eq_2]
        refine congrArg pure ?_
        have hmain :
          (do
            let a ← strat
            let rest_1 ←
              StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat
                (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix
                  (s₂ := fun p => s₂ ⟨a.1, p⟩)
                  (r₁ := rRest a.1)
                  (r₂ := fun p => r₂ ⟨a.1, p⟩) a.2)
                (fun _ strat₂ => pure strat₂)
            pure ⟨a.1, rest_1⟩) = strat >>= pure := by
                refine congrArg (fun k => strat >>= k) ?_
                funext xc
                rcases xc with ⟨x, tail⟩
                let Suffix : X → Type u := fun y =>
                  StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) TwoParty.Participant.focal
                    ((fun b => PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest b) (fun path => s₂ ⟨b, path⟩)) y)
                    ((fun y =>
                      PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append
                        (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1}) (β := PUnit.{u+1})
                        (rRest y) (fun p => r₂ ⟨y, p⟩)) y)
                    (fun tr => Output ⟨y, tr⟩)
                have hgo :
                    (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat
                      (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix tail)
                      (fun _ strat₂ => pure strat₂)) = pure tail :=
                  go (rest x) (rRest x)
                    (s₂ := fun p => s₂ ⟨x, p⟩)
                    (r₂ := fun p => r₂ ⟨x, p⟩) tail
                exact (congrArg (fun a => (do let rest ← a; pure (Sigma.mk (β := Suffix) x rest)))
                  hgo).trans (pure_bind tail _)
        refine (bind_map_left _ strat _).trans ?_
        exact hmain.trans (bind_pure strat)
    | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ =>
        refine congrArg pure ?_
        funext x
        simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix.eq_3]
        have hcont :
            strat x >>= (fun next =>
              StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat
                (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix
                  (s₂ := fun p => s₂ ⟨x, p⟩)
                  (r₁ := rRest x)
                  (r₂ := fun p => r₂ ⟨x, p⟩) next)
                (fun _ strat₂ => pure strat₂)) =
              strat x >>= fun next => pure next := by
          refine congrArg (fun k => strat x >>= k) ?_
          funext next
          exact go (rest x) (rRest x)
            (s₂ := fun p => s₂ ⟨x, p⟩)
            (r₂ := fun p => r₂ ⟨x, p⟩) next
        refine (bind_map_left
          (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.splitPrefix (s₂ := fun p => s₂ ⟨x, p⟩)
            (r₁ := rRest x) (r₂ := fun p => r₂ ⟨x, p⟩)) (strat x) _).trans ?_
        exact hcont.trans (bind_pure (strat x))
  exact go s₁ r₁ strat

name: _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append_eq_appendFlat_mapOutput
statement:
theorem _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append_eq_appendFlat_mapOutput
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] :
    {s₁ : TypeTree} → {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree} →
    {r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁} →
    {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)} →
    {Output₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → Type u} →
    {F : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₂ tr₁) → Type u} →
    (c₁ : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart s₁ r₁ Output₁) →
    (c₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → Output₁ tr₁ →
      StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁) (F tr₁)) →
    StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append c₁ c₂ =
      StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat c₁ (fun tr₁ o =>
        StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
          (fun tr₂ x => PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ F tr₁ tr₂ x) (c₂ tr₁ o))
  | .done, _, _, _, _, _, c₁, c₂ => by
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append,
        StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat, PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend]
      exact (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput_id _).symm
  | .node _ rest, _, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, _, _, _, c₁, c₂ => by
      funext x
      refine congrArg (fun k => c₁ x >>= k) ?_
      funext cRest
      exact congrArg pure
        (append_eq_appendFlat_mapOutput cRest (fun p o => c₂ ⟨x, p⟩ o))
  | .node _ rest, _, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, _, _, _, c₁, c₂ => by
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append,
        StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat]
      congr 1; funext ⟨x, cRest⟩; congr 1
      simp only [PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend]; congr 1
      exact append_eq_appendFlat_mapOutput cRest (fun p o => c₂ ⟨x, p⟩ o)

/
`mapOutput packAppend` on the suffix strategy produced by the continuation. -/

name: _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp_eq_compFlat_mapOutput
statement:
theorem _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp_eq_compFlat_mapOutput
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] :
    {s₁ : TypeTree} → {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree} →
    {r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁} →
    {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)} →
    {Mid : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → Type u} →
    {F : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₂ tr₁) → Type u} →
    (strat₁ : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal s₁ r₁ Mid) →
    (f : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → Mid tr₁ →
      m (StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁) (F tr₁))) →
    StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp strat₁ f =
      StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat strat₁ (fun tr₁ mid => do
        let strat₂ ← f tr₁ mid
        pure (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
          (fun tr₂ x => PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ F tr₁ tr₂ x) strat₂))
  | .done, s₂, r₁, r₂, Mid, F, strat₁, f => by
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat,
        PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend]
      symm
      calc
        (do
          let strat₂ ← f ⟨⟩ strat₁
          pure (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput (fun tr₂ x => x) strat₂)) =
            (fun strat₂ =>
              StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput (fun tr₂ x => x) strat₂) <$>
              f ⟨⟩ strat₁
proof:
:= bind_pure_comp _ _
        _ = (fun strat₂ => strat₂) <$> f ⟨⟩ strat₁ := by
          congr 1
          funext strat₂
          rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput_id]
        _ = f ⟨⟩ strat₁ := LawfulFunctor.id_map _
  | .node X rest, s₂, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, r₂, Mid, F, strat₁, f => by
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat]
      refine congrArg pure ?_
      apply bind_congr
      intro xc
      cases xc with
      | mk x next =>
          let Tail : X → Type u := fun x =>
            StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
              (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
              (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
              (fun tr => PFunctor.FreeM.Path.liftAppend (TypeTree.node X rest) s₂ F ⟨x, tr⟩)
          exact congrArg (fun z => z >>= fun tail => pure (⟨x, tail⟩ : (x : X) × Tail x))
            (comp_eq_compFlat_mapOutput next (fun p o => f ⟨x, p⟩ o))
  | .node X rest, s₂, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, r₂, Mid, F, strat₁, f => by
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat]
      refine congrArg pure ?_
      funext x
      apply bind_congr
      intro next
      exact comp_eq_compFlat_mapOutput next (fun p o => f ⟨x, p⟩ o)

name: run_compFlat_appendFlat_pure
statement:
theorem run_compFlat_appendFlat_pure
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    {s₁ : TypeTree} {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree}
    {r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁}
    {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)}
    {MidP MidC : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → Type u}
    {OutputP OutputC : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₁.append s₂) → Type u}
    (strat₁ : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal s₁ r₁ MidP)

            ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
              (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => MidC ⟨x, tr⟩)) →
            ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
              (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
              (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
              (fun tr => OutputC ⟨x, tr⟩)) :=
          fun a => ⟨a.1, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat a.2
            (fun p o => cpt₂ ⟨a.1, p⟩ o)⟩
        refine (bind_map_left mapCpt cpt₁ _).trans ?_
        apply bind_congr
        intro xc
        cases xc with
        | mk x cNext =>
            let comp :
                StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
                  (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => MidP ⟨x, tr⟩) →
                m (StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
                  (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                  (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                    (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                  (fun tr => OutputP ⟨x, tr⟩)) :=
              fun next =>
                StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.compFlat next
                  (s₂ := fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩)
                  (r₂ := fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩)
                  (Output := fun tr => OutputP ⟨x, tr⟩)
                  (fun tr₁ mid => f ⟨x, tr₁⟩ mid)
            let addPrefix :
                ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x)
                  (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))) ×
                  (fun tr => OutputP ⟨x, tr⟩) tr ×
                  (fun tr => OutputC ⟨x, tr⟩) tr) →
                ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path
                  (PFunctor.FreeM.append (TypeTree.node X rest) s₂)) ×
                  OutputP tr × OutputC tr) :=
              fun a => ⟨⟨x, a.1⟩, a.2.1, a.2.2⟩
            simp only [mapCpt]
            calc
              (do
                let next ← strat₁ x
                let strat ← comp next
                let y ←
                  addPrefix <$> run
                    (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                    (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                      (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                    strat
                    (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat cNext
                      (fun tr₁ out => cpt₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩ out))
                g y) =
                  (do
                    let next ← strat₁ x
                    let strat ← comp next
                    let y ← run
                      (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                      (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                        (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                      strat
                      (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat cNext
                        (fun tr₁ out => cpt₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩ out))
                    g (addPrefix y)) := by
                      apply bind_congr
                      intro next
                      apply bind_congr
                      intro strat
                      exact bind_map_left addPrefix
                        (run
                          (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                          (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                            (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                          strat
                          (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat cNext
                            (fun tr₁ out => cpt₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩ out)))
                        g
              _ = _ := by
                apply bind_congr
                intro next
                let addPrefix₁ :
                    ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) ×
                      (fun tr => MidP ⟨x, tr⟩) tr × (fun tr => MidC ⟨x, tr⟩) tr) →
                    ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (TypeTree.node X rest)) × MidP tr × MidC tr) :=
                  fun a => ⟨⟨x, a.1⟩, a.2.1, a.2.2⟩
                calc
                  (do
                    let strat ← comp next
                    let y ← run
                      (PFunctor.FreeM.append (rest x) (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                      (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.append (rRest x)
                        (fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩))
                      strat
                      (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.appendFlat cNext
                        (fun tr₁ out => cpt₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩ out))
                    g (addPrefix y)) =
                      (do
                        let r₁ ← run (rest x) (rRest x) next cNext
                        let strat₂ ← f ⟨x, r₁.1⟩ r₁.2.1
                        let r₂ ←
                          run (s₂ ⟨x, r₁.1⟩) (r₂ ⟨x, r₁.1⟩) strat₂
                            (cpt₂ ⟨x, r₁.1⟩ r₁.2.2)
                        g ⟨⟨x, PFunctor.FreeM.Path.append (rest x)
                            (fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩) r₁.1 r₂.1⟩,
                          r₂.2.1, r₂.2.2⟩) := by
                            exact go (rest x) (rRest x)
                              (s₂ := fun path => s₂ ⟨x, path⟩)
                              (r₂ := fun path => r₂ ⟨x, path⟩)
                              (OutputP := fun tr => OutputP ⟨x, tr⟩)
                              (OutputC := fun tr => OutputC ⟨x, tr⟩)
                              next
                              (fun tr₁ mid => f ⟨x, tr₁⟩ mid)
                              cNext
                              (fun tr₁ out => cpt₂ ⟨x, tr₁⟩ out)
                              (fun a => g (addPrefix a))
                  _ = _ := by
                    exact (bind_map_left addPrefix₁
                      (run (rest x) (rRest x) next cNext)
                      (fun r₁ => do
                        let strat₂ ← f r₁.1 r₁.2.1
                        let r₂ ← run (s₂ r₁.1) (r₂ r₁.1) strat₂ (cpt₂ r₁.1 r₁.2.2)
                        g ⟨PFunctor.FreeM.Path.append (TypeTree.node X rest) s₂ r₁.1 r₂.1,
                          r₂.2.1, r₂.2.2⟩)).symm
  simpa [monad_norm] using go s₁ r₁ strat₁ f cpt₁ cpt₂ pure

name: run_comp_append
statement:
theorem run_comp_append
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulCommMonad m]
    {s₁ : TypeTree} {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree}
    {r₁ : RoleDecoration s₁}
    {r₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → RoleDecoration (s₂ tr₁)}
    {MidP MidC : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → Type u}
    {FP FC : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → PFunctor.FreeM.Path (s₂ tr₁) → Type u}
    (strat₁ : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal s₁ r₁ MidP)
    (f : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → MidP tr₁ →
      m (StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁) (FP tr₁)))
    (cpt₁ : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart s₁ r₁ MidC)
    (cpt₂ : (tr₁ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁) → MidC tr₁ →
      StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁) (FC tr₁)) :
    (do
      let strat ← StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp strat₁ f
      run (s₁.append s₂) (r₁.append r₂) strat
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append cpt₁ cpt₂)) =
      (do
        let ⟨tr₁, mid, out₁⟩ ← run s₁ r₁ strat₁ cpt₁
        let strat₂ ← f tr₁ mid
        let ⟨tr₂, outP, outC⟩ ←
          run (s₂ tr₁) (r₂ tr₁) strat₂ (cpt₂ tr₁ out₁)
        pure ⟨PFunctor.FreeM.Path.append s₁ s₂ tr₁ tr₂,
          PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ FP tr₁ tr₂ outP,
          PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ FC tr₁ tr₂ outC⟩)
proof:
:= by
    rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.comp_eq_compFlat_mapOutput]
    rw [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.append_eq_appendFlat_mapOutput]
    simpa [monad_norm, run_mapOutput_mapOutput] using
      (run_compFlat_appendFlat
        (s₁ := s₁) (s₂ := s₂) (r₁ := r₁) (r₂ := r₂)
        (strat₁ := strat₁)
        (f := fun tr₁ mid => do
          let strat₂ ← f tr₁ mid
          pure (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
            (fun tr₂ x => PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ FP tr₁ tr₂ x) strat₂))
        (cpt₁ := cpt₁)
        (cpt₂ := fun tr₁ out =>
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
            (fun tr₂ x => PFunctor.FreeM.Path.packAppend s₁ s₂ FC tr₁ tr₂ x)
            (cpt₂ tr₁ out)))

name: RoleDecoration.swap_replicate
statement:
theorem RoleDecoration.swap_replicate {spec : TypeTree}
    (roles : RoleDecoration spec) (n : Nat) :
    RoleDecoration.swap
        (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.replicate
          (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1}) PUnit.unit roles n) =
      PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.replicate
        (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1}) PUnit.unit (RoleDecoration.swap roles) n
proof:
:=
  PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.map_replicate
    (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1})
    (fun _ => Role.swap) PUnit.unit roles n

name: Role.swap_swap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem Role.swap_swap (r : Role) : r.swap.swap = r

name: RoleDecoration.swap_swap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem RoleDecoration.swap_swap : (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) →
    roles.swap.swap = roles
proof:
:= by
  intro spec roles
  unfold RoleDecoration.swap
  rw [PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.map_comp]
  rw [show (fun _ => Role.swap ∘ Role.swap) = (fun _ r => r) by
    funext _ r
    exact Role.swap_swap r]
  exact PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.map_id spec roles

name: RoleDecoration.swap_append
statement:
theorem RoleDecoration.swap_append {s₁ : TypeTree.{u}} {s₂ : PFunctor.FreeM.Path s₁ → TypeTree.{u}}

    RoleDecoration.swap (r₁.append r₂) =

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem map_id {S : Type u → Type v} :
    (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) → (rr : Role.Refine S spec roles) →
    map (fun X (s : S X) => s) spec roles rr = rr
  | .done, _, _ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ => by
      simp only [map]; congr 1; funext x
      exact map_id (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, rr => by
      funext x
      simp only [map]
      exact map_id (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {S : Type u → Type v} {T : Type u → Type w} {U : Type u → Type w₂}
    (g : ∀ X, T X → U X) (f : ∀ X, S X → T X) :
    (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) → (rr : Role.Refine S spec roles) →
    map g spec roles (map f spec roles rr) =
      map (fun X => g X ∘ f X) spec roles rr
  | .done, _, _ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ => by
      simp only [map]; congr 1; funext x
      exact map_comp g f (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, rr => by
      funext x
      simp only [map]
      exact map_comp g f (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

name: map_append
proof:
:= by
  induction s₁ with
  | done => rfl
  | node X rest ih =>
    rcases rd₁ with ⟨role, rRest⟩
    cases role with
    | sender =>
      rcases sd₁ with ⟨_s, rr⟩
      simp only [append, map]
      refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
      funext x
      exact ih x (rr x) (fun p => sd₂ ⟨x, p⟩)
    | receiver =>
      simp only [append, map]
      funext x
      exact ih x (sd₁ x) (fun p => sd₂ ⟨x, p⟩)

name: map_replicate
statement:
theorem map_replicate {S T : Type u → Type v} (f : ∀ X, S X → T X)
    {spec : TypeTree} {roles : RoleDecoration spec}
    (sd : Role.Refine S spec roles) (n : Nat) :
    map f (spec.replicate n)
        (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.replicate
          (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1}) PUnit.unit roles n)
        (replicate sd n) =
      replicate (map f spec roles sd) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [replicate, PFunctor.FreeM.replicate_succ,
      PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.replicate_succ]
    rw [map_append f sd (fun _ => replicate sd n)]
    refine congrArg (append (map f spec roles sd)) ?_
    funext _
    exact ih

name: map_stateChain
statement:
theorem map_stateChain {S T : Type u → Type v} (f : ∀ X, S X → T X)
    {Stage : Nat → Type u} {spec : (i : Nat) → Stage i → TypeTree}
    {advance : (i : Nat) → (s : Stage i) → PFunctor.FreeM.Path (spec i s) → Stage (i + 1)}
    {roles : (i : Nat) → (s : Stage i) → RoleDecoration (spec i s)}
    (sdeco : (i : Nat) → (s : Stage i) → Role.Refine S (spec i s) (roles i s)) :
    (n : Nat) → (i : Nat) → (s : Stage i) →
    map f (PFunctor.FreeM.stateChain PUnit.unit Stage spec advance n i s)
        (PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.stateChain
          (P := TypeTree.basePFunctor) (α := PUnit.{u+1}) (a := PUnit.unit)
          (advance := advance) roles n i s)
        (stateChain sdeco n i s) =
      stateChain (fun j t => map f (spec j t) (roles j t) (sdeco j t)) n i s
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, i, s => by
      simp only [PFunctor.FreeM.stateChain_succ, stateChain,
        PFunctor.FreeM.Displayed.Decoration.stateChain_succ]
      rw [map_append f (sdeco i s)
            (fun tr => stateChain sdeco n (i + 1) (advance i s tr))]
      refine congrArg (append (map f (spec i s) (roles i s) (sdeco i s))) ?_
      funext tr
      exact map_stateChain f sdeco n (i + 1) (advance i s tr)

/
data at each node to the underlying role decoration. Inverse to
`ofDecorationOver`. -/
@[expose]
def toDecorationOver {S : Type u → Type v} :
    (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) →
    Role.Refine S spec roles →
    Decoration.Over (fun _ => Role) (fun X r => Role.SenderData S X r) spec roles
  | .done, _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ =>
      ⟨s, fun x => toDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)⟩
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, rr =>
      ⟨⟨⟩, fun x => toDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)⟩

/
data over the role decoration. Inverse to `toDecorationOver`. -/
@[expose]
def ofDecorationOver {S : Type u → Type v} :
    (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) →
    Decoration.Over (fun _ => Role) (fun X r => Role.SenderData S X r) spec roles →
    Role.Refine S spec roles
  | .done, _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ =>
      ⟨s, fun x => ofDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)⟩
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, ⟨_, rr⟩ =>
      fun x => ofDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

@[simp]

name: toDecorationOver_ofDecorationOver
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDecorationOver_ofDecorationOver {S : Type u → Type v} :
    ∀ (spec : TypeTree) (roles : RoleDecoration spec)
      (dr : Decoration.Over (fun _ => Role) (fun X r => Role.SenderData S X r) spec roles),
      toDecorationOver spec roles (ofDecorationOver spec roles dr) = dr
  | .done, _, ⟨⟩ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ => by
      simp only [toDecorationOver, ofDecorationOver]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact toDecorationOver_ofDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, ⟨u, rr⟩ => by
      cases u
      simp only [toDecorationOver, ofDecorationOver]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact toDecorationOver_ofDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

@[simp]

name: ofDecorationOver_toDecorationOver
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDecorationOver_toDecorationOver {S : Type u → Type v} :
    ∀ (spec : TypeTree) (roles : RoleDecoration spec)
      (rr : Role.Refine S spec roles),
      ofDecorationOver spec roles (toDecorationOver spec roles rr) = rr
  | .done, _, ⟨⟩ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ => by
      simp only [toDecorationOver, ofDecorationOver]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact ofDecorationOver_toDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, rr => by
      funext x
      simp only [toDecorationOver, ofDecorationOver]
      exact ofDecorationOver_toDecorationOver (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

/
def equivDecorationOver {S : Type u → Type v}
    (spec : TypeTree) (roles : RoleDecoration spec) :
    Equiv (Role.Refine S spec roles)
      (Decoration.Over (fun _ => Role) (fun X r => Role.SenderData S X r) spec roles) where
  toFun
proof:
:= toDecorationOver spec roles
  invFun := ofDecorationOver spec roles
  left_inv rr := ofDecorationOver_toDecorationOver spec roles rr
  right_inv dr := toDecorationOver_ofDecorationOver spec roles dr

name: toDecorationOver_map
statement:
theorem toDecorationOver_map {S T : Type u → Type v} (f : ∀ X, S X → T X) :
    (spec : TypeTree) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) → (rr : Role.Refine S spec roles) →
    toDecorationOver spec roles (map f spec roles rr) =
      Decoration.Over.map (fun X r => Role.SenderData.map f X r) spec roles
        (toDecorationOver spec roles rr)
  | .done, _, _ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩, ⟨s, rr⟩ => by
      simp only [toDecorationOver, map, Decoration.Over.map]
      congr 1; funext x
      exact toDecorationOver_map f (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩, rr => by
      simp only [toDecorationOver, map, Decoration.Over.map]
      congr 1; funext x
      exact toDecorationOver_map f (rest x) (rRest x) (rr x)

      TypeTree.Ownership.syntaxOver
        (fun role agent => typeTreePerspective role agent)
        (fun {X} _role _agent =>
          { own := fun Cont => m ((x : X) × Cont x)
            other := fun Cont => (x : X) → m (Cont x) })

name: _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput_id
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Functor m] [LawfulFunctor m]
    {spec : TypeTree} {roles : RoleDecoration spec} {A : PFunctor.FreeM.Path spec → Type u}
    (σ : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal spec roles A) :
    StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput (fun _ x => x) σ = σ
proof:
:= by
  match spec, roles with
  | .done, roles =>
      cases roles
      rfl
  | .node X rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ =>
      let F :
          ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩)) →
          ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩)) :=
        fun xc => ⟨xc.1,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
            (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest xc.1)) (y : A ⟨xc.1, p⟩) => y) xc.2⟩
      have hpair : F = id := by
        funext xc
        cases xc with
        | mk x σ' =>
            simp only [F]
            have h :
                StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
                  (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y) σ' = σ' := by
              simpa using
                (@StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput_id m _ _
                  (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩) σ')
            exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq h)
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput,
        ShapeOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree, ShapeOver.TwoParty.paired, PFunctor.Lens.id]
      change F <$> σ = σ
      rw [hpair]
      exact LawfulFunctor.id_map σ
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ =>
      funext x
      have hid : ∀ s : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩),
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
            (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y) s = s :=
        fun s =>
          @StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput_id m _ _
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩) s
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput,
        ShapeOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree, ShapeOver.TwoParty.paired, PFunctor.Lens.id]
      calc (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput
              (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y) ·) <$> σ x
          = id <$> σ x := by congr 1; funext s; exact hid s
        _ = σ x := LawfulFunctor.id_map (σ x)

@[simp]
theorem _root_.Interaction.StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput_id
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Functor m] [LawfulFunctor m]
    {spec : TypeTree} {roles : RoleDecoration spec} {A : PFunctor.FreeM.Path spec → Type u}
    (c : StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart spec roles A) :
    StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput (fun _ x => x) c = c
proof:
:= by
  match spec, roles with
  | .done, roles =>
      cases roles
      simp [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput]
  | .node _ rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ =>
      funext x
      have hid : ∀ c' : StrategyOver
            (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩),
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
            (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y) c' = c' :=
        fun c' =>
          @StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput_id m _ _
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩) c'
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput,
        ShapeOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree, ShapeOver.TwoParty.paired, PFunctor.Lens.id]
      change
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
          (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y)) <$> c x = c x
      calc (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput (fun p y => y) ·) <$> c x
          = id <$> c x := by congr 1; funext c'; exact hid c'
        _ = c x := LawfulFunctor.id_map (c x)
  | .node X rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ =>
      let F :
          ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩)) →
          ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
            (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩)) :=
        fun xc => ⟨xc.1,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
            (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest xc.1)) (y : A ⟨xc.1, p⟩) => y) xc.2⟩
      have hpair :
          F = id := by
        funext xc
        cases xc with
        | mk x c' =>
            simp only [F]
            have h :
                StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
                  (fun (p : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest x)) (y : A ⟨x, p⟩) => y) c' = c' := by
              simpa using
                (@StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput_id m _ _
                  (rest x) (rRest x) (fun p => A ⟨x, p⟩) c')
            exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq h)
      simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput,
        ShapeOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree, ShapeOver.TwoParty.paired, PFunctor.Lens.id]
      change F <$> c = c
      rw [hpair]
      exact LawfulFunctor.id_map c

name: _root_.Interaction.InteractionOver.TwoParty.run_paired_sender
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Interaction.InteractionOver.TwoParty.run_paired_sender
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m]
    {X : Type u} {rest : X → TypeTree} {rRest : (x : X) → RoleDecoration (rest x)}
    {OutputP OutputC : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (TypeTree.node X rest) → Type u}
    (send :
      m ((x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
        (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => OutputP ⟨x, tr⟩)))
    (dualFn : (x : X) → m (StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
        (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => OutputC ⟨x, tr⟩))) :
    InteractionOver.runTypeTree
      (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := TypeTree.node X rest)
      (ctxs := ⟨.sender, rRest⟩)
      (participantProfile
        (show StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
          (TypeTree.node X rest) ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ OutputP from send)
        (show StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
          (TypeTree.node X rest) ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ OutputC from dualFn))
      collectParticipantOutputs = (do
      let xc ← send
      let dualNext ← dualFn xc.1
      let tailOut ← InteractionOver.runTypeTree
        (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := rest xc.1)
        (ctxs := rRest xc.1)
        (participantProfile xc.2 dualNext) collectParticipantOutputs
      pure ⟨⟨xc.1, tailOut.1⟩, tailOut.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [InteractionOver.runTypeTree, InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree,
    SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree, participantOutputFamily, participantProfile,
    collectParticipantOutputs]
  apply congrArg (fun k => send >>= k)
  funext xc
  apply congrArg (fun k => dualFn xc.1 >>= k)
  funext dualNext
  rfl

          (TypeTree.node X rest) ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ OutputC from dualSample))

name: _root_.Interaction.InteractionOver.TwoParty.run_paired_mapOutput_mapOutput
statement:
theorem _root_.Interaction.InteractionOver.TwoParty.run_paired_mapOutput_mapOutput
    {m : Type u → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    {spec : TypeTree} {roles : RoleDecoration spec}
    {OutputP OutputP' OutputC OutputC' : PFunctor.FreeM.Path spec → Type u}
    (fP : ∀ tr, OutputP tr → OutputP' tr)
    (fC : ∀ tr, OutputC tr → OutputC' tr)
    (strat : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal spec roles OutputP)
    (cpt : StrategyOver
      (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart spec roles OutputC) :
    InteractionOver.runTypeTree
      (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := spec) (ctxs := roles)
      (participantProfile
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput fP strat)
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput fC cpt))
      collectParticipantOutputs =
      (fun z => ⟨z.1, fP z.1 z.2.1, fC z.1 z.2.2⟩) <$>
        InteractionOver.runTypeTree
          (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := spec) (ctxs := roles)
          (participantProfile strat cpt) collectParticipantOutputs
proof:
:= by
  let rec go
      (spec : TypeTree) (roles : RoleDecoration spec)
      {OutputP OutputP' OutputC OutputC' : PFunctor.FreeM.Path spec → Type u}
      (fP : ∀ tr, OutputP tr → OutputP' tr)
      (fC : ∀ tr, OutputC tr → OutputC' tr)
      (strat : StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal spec roles OutputP)
      (cpt : StrategyOver
        (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart spec roles OutputC) :
      InteractionOver.runTypeTree
        (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := spec) (ctxs := roles)
        (participantProfile
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput fP strat)
        (StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput fC cpt))
        collectParticipantOutputs =
        (fun z => ⟨z.1, fP z.1 z.2.1, fC z.1 z.2.2⟩) <$>
          InteractionOver.runTypeTree
            (I := InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) (spec := spec) (ctxs := roles)
            (participantProfile strat cpt) collectParticipantOutputs := by
    match spec, roles with
    | .done, roles =>
        cases roles
        simp [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput, ShapeOver.mapOutput,
          InteractionOver.runTypeTree,
          participantProfile, collectParticipantOutputs]
    | .node X rest, ⟨.sender, rRest⟩ =>
        simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput]
        simp only [InteractionOver.runTypeTree, InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree,
          InteractionOver.TwoParty.paired, SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree,
          participantOutputFamily, participantProfile, collectParticipantOutputs, bind_pure_comp]
        refine (bind_map_left
          (fun xc =>
            (⟨xc.1, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput (fun p => fP ⟨xc.1, p⟩) xc.2⟩ :
              (x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.focal
                (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => OutputP' ⟨x, tr⟩)))
          strat _).trans ?_
        simp only [map_bind, Functor.map_map]
        refine congrArg (fun k => strat >>= k) ?_
        funext xc
        refine (bind_map_left
          (fun cNext =>
            StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput (fun p => fC ⟨xc.1, p⟩) cNext)
          (cpt xc.1) _).trans ?_
        refine congrArg (fun k => cpt xc.1 >>= k) ?_
        funext cNext
        let addPrefix :
            ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest xc.1)) × (fun tr => OutputP' ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) tr ×
              (fun tr => OutputC' ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) tr) →
            ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (TypeTree.node _ rest)) × OutputP' tr × OutputC' tr) :=
          fun a => ⟨⟨xc.1, a.1⟩, a.2.1, a.2.2⟩
        have h := congrArg (fun z => addPrefix <$> z)
          (go (rest xc.1) (rRest xc.1) (fun tr => fP ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) (fun tr => fC ⟨xc.1, tr⟩)
            xc.2 cNext)
        rw [Functor.map_map] at h
        exact h
    | .node X rest, ⟨.receiver, rRest⟩ =>
        simp only [StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput,
          StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput]
        simp only [InteractionOver.runTypeTree, InteractionOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree,
          InteractionOver.TwoParty.paired, SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree,
          participantOutputFamily, participantProfile, collectParticipantOutputs, bind_pure_comp]
        refine (bind_map_left
          (fun xc =>
            (⟨xc.1, StrategyOver.TwoParty.Counterpart.mapOutput
              (fun p => fC ⟨xc.1, p⟩) xc.2⟩ :
              (x : X) × StrategyOver (SyntaxOver.TwoParty.pairedTypeTree m) Participant.counterpart
                (rest x) (rRest x) (fun tr => OutputC' ⟨x, tr⟩)))
          cpt _).trans ?_
        simp only [map_bind, Functor.map_map]
        refine congrArg (fun k => cpt >>= k) ?_
        funext xc
        refine (bind_map_left
          (fun next => StrategyOver.TwoParty.Focal.mapOutput (fun p => fP ⟨xc.1, p⟩) next)
          (strat xc.1) _).trans ?_
        refine congrArg (fun k => strat xc.1 >>= k) ?_
        funext next
        let addPrefix :
            ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (rest xc.1)) × (fun tr => OutputP' ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) tr ×
              (fun tr => OutputC' ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) tr) →
            ((tr : PFunctor.FreeM.Path (TypeTree.node _ rest)) × OutputP' tr × OutputC' tr) :=
          fun a => ⟨⟨xc.1, a.1⟩, a.2.1, a.2.2⟩
        have h := congrArg (fun z => addPrefix <$> z)
          (go (rest xc.1) (rRest xc.1) (fun tr => fP ⟨xc.1, tr⟩) (fun tr => fC ⟨xc.1, tr⟩)
            next xc.2)
        rw [Functor.map_map] at h
        exact h
  exact go spec roles fP fC strat cpt

statement:
theorem withMonads_constant_eq_map
    (bm : BundledMonad.{u, u}) :
    (spec : TypeTree.{u}) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) →
    RoleDecoration.withMonads roles (TypeTree.MonadDecoration.constant bm spec) =
      Decoration.map (RoleContext.withMonad bm) spec roles
  | .done, _ => rfl
  | .node _ rest, ⟨role, rRest⟩ => by
      simp only [RoleDecoration.withMonads, RoleDecoration.monadsOver,
        TypeTree.MonadDecoration.constant, MonadDecoration.constant,
        Decoration.ofOver]
      change
        (⟨⟨role, bm⟩,
          fun x =>
            RoleDecoration.withMonads (rRest x)
              (TypeTree.MonadDecoration.constant bm (rest x))⟩ :
          Decoration RoleMonadContext (TypeTree.node _ rest)) =
          ⟨⟨role, bm⟩,
            fun x => Decoration.map (RoleContext.withMonad bm) (rest x) (rRest x)⟩
      congr
      funext x
      exact withMonads_constant_eq_map bm (rest x) (rRest x)

/
def pairedMonadsOver :
    (spec : TypeTree.{u}) → (roles : RoleDecoration spec) →
    (stratDeco : TypeTree.MonadDecoration spec) → (cptDeco : TypeTree.MonadDecoration spec) →
    Decoration.Over
      (fun _ => Role) (fun _ (_ : Role) => BundledMonad.{u, u} × BundledMonad.{u, u}) spec roles
  | .done, _, _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .node _ rest, ⟨_, rRest⟩, ⟨bmS, mRestS⟩, ⟨bmC, mRestC⟩ =>
      ⟨(bmS, bmC), fun x => pairedMonadsOver (rest x) (rRest x) (mRestS x) (mRestC x)⟩

/
def withPairedMonads {spec : TypeTree.{u}}
    (roles : RoleDecoration spec) (stratDeco : TypeTree.MonadDecoration spec)
    (cptDeco : TypeTree.MonadDecoration spec) :
    Decoration RolePairedMonadContext spec
proof:
:=
  Decoration.ofOver spec roles (pairedMonadsOver spec roles stratDeco cptDeco)
