name: wpFold_pure
statement:
@[simp, freeM_unfold]
theorem wpFold_pure (Φ : OpSpec P l) (x : α) (post : α → l) :
    wpFold Φ (pure x : FreeM P α) post = post x

name: wpFold_liftBind
statement:
@[freeM_unfold]
theorem wpFold_liftBind (Φ : OpSpec P l) (a : P.A) (r : P.B a → FreeM P α)
    (post : α → l) :
    wpFold Φ (FreeM.liftBind a r) post = Φ a fun b => wpFold Φ (r b) post

name: wpFold_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wpFold_lift (Φ : OpSpec P l) (a : P.A) (post : P.B a → l) :
    wpFold Φ (FreeM.lift (P := P) a) post = Φ a post

name: wpFold_bind
statement:
theorem wpFold_bind (Φ : OpSpec P l) (x : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β)
    (post : β → l) :
    wpFold Φ (x >>= f) post = wpFold Φ x fun a => wpFold Φ (f a) post
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => rfl
  | lift_bind a r ih => exact congrArg (Φ a) (funext fun b => ih b)

name: wpFold_mono
statement:
theorem wpFold_mono [Preorder l] {Φ : OpSpec P l} (hΦ : Φ.Mono) (x : FreeM P α)
    {post post' : α → l} (h : ∀ a, post a ≤ post' a) :
    wpFold Φ x post ≤ wpFold Φ x post'
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => exact h x
  | lift_bind a r ih => exact hΦ a fun b => ih b

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_pure (allows : (a : P.A) → P.B a → Prop)
    (accept : α → Prop) (result : α) :
    (pure result : FreeM P α).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept ↔ accept result

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_liftBind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_liftBind (allows : (a : P.A) → P.B a → Prop)
    (accept : α → Prop) (position : P.A) (next : P.B position → FreeM P α) :
    ((FreeM.lift position).bind next).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept ↔
      ∀ direction, allows position direction →
        (next direction).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept

name: LeavesSatisfyUnder.mono
statement:
theorem LeavesSatisfyUnder.mono {allows : (a : P.A) → P.B a → Prop}
    {accept accept' : α → Prop} (haccept : ∀ result, accept result → accept' result)
    {program : FreeM P α} (h : program.LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept) :
    program.LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept'

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_map_iff
statement:
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_map_iff (allows : (a : P.A) → P.B a → Prop)
    {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} (accept : Y → Prop) (function : X → Y)
    (program : FreeM P X) :
    (FreeM.map function program).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept ↔
      program.LeavesSatisfyUnder allows (accept ∘ function)
proof:
:= by
  induction program with
  | pure result => rfl
  | lift_bind position next ih =>
      change
        (∀ direction, allows position direction →
          (FreeM.map function (next direction)).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept) ↔
        ∀ direction, allows position direction →
          (next direction).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows (accept ∘ function)
      exact forall_congr' fun direction =>
        imp_congr_right fun _ => ih direction

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_bind_iff
statement:
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_bind_iff (allows : (a : P.A) → P.B a → Prop)
    {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} (accept : Y → Prop) (program : FreeM P X)
    (next : X → FreeM P Y) :
    (FreeM.bind program next).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept ↔
      program.LeavesSatisfyUnder allows
        (fun result => (next result).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept)
proof:
:= by
  induction program with
  | pure result => rfl
  | lift_bind position continuation ih =>
      change
        (∀ direction, allows position direction →
          (FreeM.bind (continuation direction) next).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept) ↔
        ∀ direction, allows position direction →
          (continuation direction).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows
            (fun result => (next result).LeavesSatisfyUnder allows accept)
      exact forall_congr' fun direction =>
        imp_congr_right fun _ => ih direction

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_liftM
statement:
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_liftM
    (handler : (position : P.A) → FreeM Q (P.B position))
    (outerAllows : (position : P.A) → P.B position → Prop)
    (innerAllows : (position : Q.A) → Q.B position → Prop)
    (accept : α → Prop)
    (hhandler : ∀ position,
      (handler position).LeavesSatisfyUnder innerAllows (outerAllows position))
    (program : FreeM P α)
    (hprogram : program.LeavesSatisfyUnder outerAllows accept) :
    (program.liftM handler).LeavesSatisfyUnder innerAllows accept
proof:
:= by
  induction program with
  | pure result => exact hprogram
  | lift_bind position next ih =>
      change
        (handler position >>= fun direction =>
          (next direction).liftM handler).LeavesSatisfyUnder innerAllows accept
      change
        (FreeM.bind (handler position)
          (fun direction => (next direction).liftM handler)).LeavesSatisfyUnder
          innerAllows accept
      rw [leavesSatisfyUnder_bind_iff]
      exact (hhandler position).mono fun direction hdirection =>
        ih direction (hprogram direction hdirection)

name: wp_toMAlgOrdered
statement:
theorem wp_toMAlgOrdered {l : Type v} [CompleteLattice l]
    (Φ : OpSpec P l) (hΦ : Φ.Mono) (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → l) :
    letI
proof:
:= Φ.toMAlgOrdered hΦ
    MAlgOrdered.wp x post = wpFold Φ x post := by
  change wpFold Φ (x >>= fun a => pure (post a)) id = _
  rw [wpFold_bind]
  rfl

name: wpVia_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wpVia_pure (s : Handler m P) (x : α) (post : α → l) :
    wpVia s (pure x : FreeM P α) post = post x

name: wpVia_bind
statement:
theorem wpVia_bind (s : Handler m P) (x : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β)
    (post : β → l) :
    wpVia s (x >>= f) post = wpVia s x fun a => wpVia s (f a) post

name: wpVia_liftBind
statement:
theorem wpVia_liftBind (s : Handler m P) (a : P.A) (r : P.B a → FreeM P α)
    (post : α → l) :
    wpVia s (FreeM.liftBind a r) post =
      MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) fun b => wpVia s (r b) post
proof:
:= by
  rw [wpVia, show (FreeM.liftBind a r : FreeM P α) = FreeM.lift a >>= r from rfl,
    FreeM.liftM_bind, FreeM.liftM_lift, MAlgOrdered.wp_bind]
  rfl

name: wpFold_le_wpVia
statement:
theorem wpFold_le_wpVia {Φ : OpSpec P l} (s : Handler m P)
    (h : ∀ (a : P.A) (k : P.B a → l), Φ a k ≤ MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) k)
    (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → l) :
    wpFold Φ x post ≤ wpVia s x post
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => rw [wpFold_pure, wpVia_pure]
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      calc Φ a (fun b => wpFold Φ (r b) post)
          ≤ MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) fun b => wpFold Φ (r b) post := h a _
        _ ≤ MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) fun b => wpVia s (r b) post :=
            MAlgOrdered.wp_mono _ fun b => ih b
        _ = wpVia s (FreeM.liftBind a r) post := (wpVia_liftBind s a r post).symm

name: wpFold_eq_wpVia
statement:
theorem wpFold_eq_wpVia {Φ : OpSpec P l} (s : Handler m P)
    (h : ∀ (a : P.A) (k : P.B a → l), Φ a k = MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) k)
    (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → l) :
    wpFold Φ x post = wpVia s x post
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => rw [wpFold_pure, wpVia_pure]
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      rw [show ((FreeM.lift a).bind r : FreeM P α) = FreeM.liftBind a r from rfl,
        wpFold_liftBind, wpVia_liftBind, h a]
      exact congrArg _ (funext fun b => ih b)

name: leavesSatisfyUnder_all_iff_allOutputs
statement:
theorem leavesSatisfyUnder_all_iff_allOutputs (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → Prop) :
    x.LeavesSatisfyUnder (fun _ _ => True) post ↔ AllOutputs post x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => simp
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      rw [leavesSatisfyUnder_liftBind]
      rw [show ((FreeM.lift a).bind r : FreeM P α) = FreeM.liftBind a r from rfl,
        allOutputs_liftBind]
      simp only [true_implies]
      exact forall_congr' fun b => ih b

name: wpFold_demonic_iff_allOutputs
statement:
theorem wpFold_demonic_iff_allOutputs (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → Prop) :
    wpFold (OpSpec.demonic P) x post ↔ AllOutputs post x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => simp
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      rw [show ((FreeM.lift a).bind r : FreeM P α) = FreeM.liftBind a r from rfl,
        wpFold_liftBind, allOutputs_liftBind]
      exact forall_congr' fun b => ih b

name: wpFold_angelic_iff_someOutput
statement:
theorem wpFold_angelic_iff_someOutput (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → Prop) :
    wpFold (OpSpec.angelic P) x post ↔ SomeOutput post x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => simp
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      rw [show ((FreeM.lift a).bind r : FreeM P α) = FreeM.liftBind a r from rfl,
        wpFold_liftBind, someOutput_liftBind]
      exact exists_congr fun b => ih b

name: wpFold_demonic_not_iff_noOutput
statement:
theorem wpFold_demonic_not_iff_noOutput (x : FreeM P α) (post : α → Prop) :
    wpFold (OpSpec.demonic P) x (fun a => ¬ post a) ↔ NoOutput post x
proof:
:=
  wpFold_demonic_iff_allOutputs x fun a => ¬ post a

name: wpVia_demonic_iff_allOutputs
statement:
theorem wpVia_demonic_iff_allOutputs (s : Handler n Q) (x : FreeM Q α) (post : α → Prop) :
    wpVia s x post ↔ AllOutputs post (x.liftM s)

name: wpVia_angelic_iff_someOutput
statement:
theorem wpVia_angelic_iff_someOutput (s : Handler n Q) (x : FreeM Q α) (post : α → Prop) :
    letI
proof:
:= MonadAttach.mAlgOrderedPropAngelic (m := n)
    wpVia s x post ↔ SomeOutput post (x.liftM s) :=
  wp_angelic_iff_someOutput _ post

name: allOutputs_liftM_of_wpFold
statement:
theorem allOutputs_liftM_of_wpFold {Φ : OpSpec Q Prop} (s : Handler n Q)
    (h : ∀ (a : Q.A) (k : Q.B a → Prop), Φ a k ≤ MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) k)
    (x : FreeM Q α) (post : α → Prop) (hx : wpFold Φ x post) :
    AllOutputs post (x.liftM s)
proof:
:=
  (wpVia_demonic_iff_allOutputs s x post).mp (wpFold_le_wpVia s h x post hx)

name: allOutputs_liftM_of_allOutputs
statement:
theorem allOutputs_liftM_of_allOutputs (s : Handler n Q)
    (h : ∀ (a : Q.A) (k : Q.B a → Prop), (∀ b, k b) → MAlgOrdered.wp (s a) k)
    (x : FreeM Q α) (post : α → Prop) (hx : AllOutputs post x) :
    AllOutputs post (x.liftM s)
proof:
:=
  allOutputs_liftM_of_wpFold s h x post
    ((wpFold_demonic_iff_allOutputs x post).mpr hx)

name: generator_toFunA
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generator_toFunA (a : P.A) :
    (generator P).toFunA a =
      FreeM.liftBind a (fun _ => FreeM.pure PUnit.unit)

name: generator_toFunB
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generator_toFunB (a : P.A)
    (path : (FreeP P).B ((generator P).toFunA a)) :
    (generator P).toFunB a path = path.1

name: foldObjAt_eq
statement:
theorem foldObjAt_eq {α : Type uB}
    (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) (label : FreeM.Path s → α) :
    foldObjAt M l s label =
      (⟨foldShape M l s, label ∘ foldPath M l s⟩ :
        M.carrier.Obj α)
proof:
:= by
  match s with
  | .pure u =>
      cases u
      rfl
  | .liftBind a rest =>
      change
        extensionHandler M l a >>= (fun d =>
          foldObjAt M l (rest d)
            (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) = _
      have hcont :
          (fun d => foldObjAt M l (rest d)
            (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) =
          (fun d =>
            (⟨foldShape M l (rest d),
              (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path)) ∘
                foldPath M l (rest d)⟩ : M.carrier.Obj α)) := by
        funext d
        exact foldObjAt_eq (rest d)
          (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))
      rw [hcont]
      rfl

name: foldObj_eq
statement:
theorem foldObj_eq (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) :
    foldObj M l s =
      (⟨foldShape M l s, foldPath M l s⟩ :
        M.carrier.Obj (FreeM.Path s))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [foldObj, Function.comp_def] using foldObjAt_eq M l s id

name: foldLens_toFunA
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldLens_toFunA (s : (FreeP P).A) :
    (foldLens M l).toFunA s = foldShape M l s

name: foldLens_toFunB
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldLens_toFunB (s : (FreeP P).A)
    (direction : M.carrier.B ((foldLens M l).toFunA s)) :
    (foldLens M l).toFunB s direction = foldPath M l s direction

name: foldLens_comp_unit
statement:
theorem foldLens_comp_unit :
    foldLens M l ∘ₗ unit (P := P) = M.unit
proof:
:= by
  apply Lens.ext _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  intro _
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: foldObjAt_append_split
statement:
theorem foldObjAt_append_split {α : Type uB}
    (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1})
    (next : FreeM.Path s → FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1})
    (label : ((path : FreeM.Path s) × FreeM.Path (next path)) → α) :
    foldObjAt M l (FreeM.append s next)
        (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.split s next path)) =
      foldObjAt M l s id >>= fun path =>
        foldObjAt M l (next path) (fun inner => label ⟨path, inner⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold foldObjAt
  rw [decodeAt_append_split, ← FreeM.monad_bind_def, FreeM.liftM_bind]

name: foldLens_mult_obj
statement:
theorem foldLens_mult_obj
    (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1})
    (next : FreeM.Path s → FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) :
    let x : (FreeP P ◃ FreeP P).A
proof:
:= ⟨s, next⟩
    Lens.mapObj (foldLens M l ∘ₗ mult (P := P))
        (⟨x, id⟩ : (FreeP P ◃ FreeP P).Obj
          ((FreeP P ◃ FreeP P).B x)) =
      Lens.mapObj (M.mult ∘ₗ (foldLens M l ◃ₗ foldLens M l))
        (⟨x, id⟩ : (FreeP P ◃ FreeP P).Obj
          ((FreeP P ◃ FreeP P).B x)) := by
  dsimp only
  have h := foldObjAt_append_split M l s next id
  rw [foldObjAt_eq M l (FreeM.append s next)] at h
  have houter : foldObjAt M l s id =
      (⟨foldShape M l s, foldPath M l s⟩ :
        M.carrier.Obj (FreeM.Path s)) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using foldObjAt_eq M l s id
  have hinner :
      (fun path => foldObjAt M l (next path)
        (fun inner =>
          (⟨path, inner⟩ :
            (outer : FreeM.Path s) × FreeM.Path (next outer)))) =
      (fun path =>
        (⟨foldShape M l (next path),
          (fun inner =>
            (⟨path, inner⟩ :
              (outer : FreeM.Path s) × FreeM.Path (next outer))) ∘
            foldPath M l (next path)⟩ :
          M.carrier.Obj
            ((outer : FreeM.Path s) × FreeM.Path (next outer)))) := by
    funext path
    exact foldObjAt_eq M l (next path) (fun inner =>
      (⟨path, inner⟩ :
        (outer : FreeM.Path s) × FreeM.Path (next outer)))
  dsimp only [id] at h
  rw [houter, hinner] at h
  simpa [PFunctor.comp, Lens.mapObj, Lens.comp, Lens.compMap,
    foldLens, mult,
    SubstMonoid.Extension.bind,
    Function.comp_def] using h

name: foldLens_comp_mult
statement:
theorem foldLens_comp_mult :
    foldLens M l ∘ₗ mult (P := P) =
      M.mult ∘ₗ (foldLens M l ◃ₗ foldLens M l)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lens.ext_mapObj
  rintro ⟨s, next⟩
  exact foldLens_mult_obj M l s next

name: foldLens_comp_generator_obj
statement:
theorem foldLens_comp_generator_obj (a : P.A) :
    Lens.mapObj (foldLens M l ∘ₗ generator P)
        (⟨a, id⟩ : P.Obj (P.B a)) =
      Lens.mapObj l (⟨a, id⟩ : P.Obj (P.B a))
proof:
:= by
  have hinterp : foldObjAt M l
      (FreeM.liftBind a (fun _ => FreeM.pure PUnit.unit))
      (fun path => path.1) = extensionHandler M l a := by
    change extensionHandler M l a >>= (fun d =>
      (Pure.pure d : SubstMonoid.Extension M (P.B a))) =
        extensionHandler M l a
    exact SubstMonoid.Extension.bind_pure M (extensionHandler M l a)
  rw [foldObjAt_eq] at hinterp
  simpa [Lens.mapObj, Lens.comp, foldLens, generator,
    extensionHandler, Function.comp_def] using hinterp

name: foldLens_comp_generator
statement:
theorem foldLens_comp_generator :
    foldLens M l ∘ₗ generator P = l
proof:
:= by
  apply Lens.ext_mapObj
  intro a
  exact foldLens_comp_generator_obj M l a

name: foldObjAt_generator_eq
statement:
theorem foldObjAt_generator_eq {α : Type uB}
    (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) (label : FreeM.Path s → α) :
    foldObjAt (substMonoid P) (generator P) s label =
      (⟨s, label⟩ : (FreeP P).Obj α)
proof:
:= by
  match s with
  | .pure u =>
      cases u
      rfl
  | .liftBind a rest =>
      change extensionHandler (substMonoid P) (generator P) a >>=
        (fun d => foldObjAt (substMonoid P) (generator P) (rest d)
          (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) = _
      have hcont :
          (fun d => foldObjAt (substMonoid P) (generator P) (rest d)
            (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) =
          (fun d =>
            (⟨rest d, fun path =>
              label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path)⟩ :
              (FreeP P).Obj α)) := by
        funext d
        exact foldObjAt_generator_eq (rest d)
          (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))
      rw [hcont]
      rfl

name: foldObjAt_generator_comp_eq
statement:
theorem foldObjAt_generator_comp_eq (lPQ : Lens P Q)
    {α : Type uB} (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1})
    (label : FreeM.Path s → α) :
    foldObjAt (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ) s label =
      Lens.mapObj (map lPQ) (⟨s, label⟩ : (FreeP P).Obj α)
proof:
:= by
  match s with
  | .pure u =>
      cases u
      rfl
  | .liftBind a rest =>
      change extensionHandler (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ) a >>=
        (fun d => foldObjAt (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)
          (rest d) (fun path =>
            label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) = _
      have hcont :
          (fun d => foldObjAt (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)
            (rest d) (fun path =>
              label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))) =
          (fun d => Lens.mapObj (map lPQ)
            (⟨rest d, fun path =>
              label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path)⟩ :
              (FreeP P).Obj α)) := by
        funext d
        exact foldObjAt_generator_comp_eq lPQ (rest d)
          (fun path => label (FreeM.Path.cons a rest d path))
      rw [hcont]
      rfl

name: foldLens_generator_comp
statement:
theorem foldLens_generator_comp (lPQ : Lens P Q) :
    foldLens (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ) = map lPQ
proof:
:= by
  let hobj : ∀ s,
      (⟨(foldLens (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)).toFunA s,
        (foldLens (substMonoid Q) (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)).toFunB s⟩ :
        (FreeP Q).Obj ((FreeP P).B s)) =
      ⟨(map lPQ).toFunA s, (map lPQ).toFunB s⟩ := fun s => by
    have h := foldObjAt_generator_comp_eq lPQ s id
    rw [foldObjAt_eq] at h
    change
      (⟨(foldLens (substMonoid Q)
          (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)).toFunA s,
        (foldLens (substMonoid Q)
          (generator Q ∘ₗ lPQ)).toFunB s⟩ :
        (FreeP Q).Obj ((FreeP P).B s)) =
      ⟨(map lPQ).toFunA s, (map lPQ).toFunB s⟩ at h
    exact h
  apply Lens.ext_mapObj
  exact hobj

name: foldShape_append
statement:
theorem foldShape_append (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1})
    (next : FreeM.Path s → FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) :
    foldShape M l (FreeM.append s next) =
      M.mult.toFunA
        ⟨foldShape M l s,
          fun direction =>
            foldShape M l (next (foldPath M l s direction))⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Sigma.fst (foldLens_mult_obj M l s next)
  simpa [Lens.mapObj, Lens.comp, Lens.compMap, foldLens, mult,
    Function.comp_def] using h

name: extensionHandler_restrict
statement:
theorem extensionHandler_restrict
    (f : SubstMonoid.Hom (substMonoid P) M) (a : P.A) :
    extensionHandler M (restrict M f) a =
      f.toMonadHom
        (extensionHandler (substMonoid P) (generator P) a)

name: hom_mapObj_eq_foldObjAt
statement:
theorem hom_mapObj_eq_foldObjAt
    (f : SubstMonoid.Hom (substMonoid P) M)
    (s : FreeM P PUnit.{uB + 1}) {α : Type uB}
    (label : FreeM.Path s → α) :
    Lens.mapObj f.toLens (⟨s, label⟩ : (FreeP P).Obj α) =
      foldObjAt M (restrict M f) s label
proof:
:= by
  have h := FreeM.liftM_natural
    (extensionHandler (substMonoid P) (generator P))
    f.toMonadHom (decodeAt s label)
  have hhandler :
      (fun a => f.toMonadHom
        (extensionHandler (substMonoid P) (generator P) a)) =
      extensionHandler M (restrict M f) := by
    funext a
    exact (extensionHandler_restrict M f a).symm
  rw [hhandler] at h
  change f.toMonadHom (foldObjAt (substMonoid P) (generator P) s label) =
    foldObjAt M (restrict M f) s label at h
  rw [foldObjAt_generator_eq] at h
  exact h

name: extend_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extend_restrict
    (f : SubstMonoid.Hom (substMonoid P) M) :
    extend M (restrict M f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply SubstMonoid.Hom.ext
  let hobj : ∀ s,
      (⟨foldShape M (restrict M f) s,
        foldPath M (restrict M f) s⟩ :
        M.carrier.Obj ((FreeP P).B s)) =
      ⟨f.toLens.toFunA s, f.toLens.toFunB s⟩ := fun s => by
    have h := hom_mapObj_eq_foldObjAt M f s id
    rw [foldObjAt_eq] at h
    change (⟨f.toLens.toFunA s, f.toLens.toFunB s⟩ :
      M.carrier.Obj ((FreeP P).B s)) =
        ⟨foldShape M (restrict M f) s,
          foldPath M (restrict M f) s⟩ at h
    exact h.symm
  apply Lens.ext_mapObj
  exact hobj

name: extend_unique
statement:
theorem extend_unique (f : SubstMonoid.Hom (substMonoid P) M)
    (h : f.toLens ∘ₗ generator P = l) : f = extend M l
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f = extend M (restrict M f) := (extend_restrict M f).symm
    _ = extend M l := congrArg (extend M) h

name: supp_map
statement:
theorem supp_map {Q : α → Prop} (x : FreeM P {a : α // Q a}) {b : α} :
    b ∈ supp (Subtype.val <$> x) → Q b
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => intro h; cases h; exact a.2
  | lift_bind op r ih =>
      intro h
      change b ∈ supp (FreeM.liftBind op fun c => Subtype.val <$> r c) at h
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
      exact ih c hc

name: map_attachSupp
statement: theorem map_attachSupp (x : FreeM P α) : Subtype.val <$> attachSupp x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op r ih =>
      change FreeM.liftBind op (fun b => Subtype.val <$>
        (FreeM.map (fun z => ⟨z.1, mem_supp_liftBind_of_mem z.2⟩) (attachSupp (r b)))) = _
      congr 1
      funext b
      rw [show (Subtype.val <$> (FreeM.map
        (fun z : {a // a ∈ supp (r b)} =>
          (⟨z.1, mem_supp_liftBind_of_mem z.2⟩ :
            {a // a ∈ supp (FreeM.liftBind op r)}))
        (attachSupp (r b)))) = Subtype.val <$> attachSupp (r b) from
        (FreeM.comp_map _ _ _).symm]
      exact ih b

name: allOutputs_liftBind
statement:
@[freeM_unfold]
theorem allOutputs_liftBind (p : α → Prop) (a : P.A) (r : P.B a → FreeM P α) :
    AllOutputs p (FreeM.liftBind a r) ↔ ∀ b, AllOutputs p (r b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h b c hc
    exact h c (mem_support_liftBind.mpr ⟨b, hc⟩)
  · intro h c hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_support_liftBind.mp hc
    exact h b c hb

name: someOutput_liftBind
statement:
@[freeM_unfold]
theorem someOutput_liftBind (p : α → Prop) (a : P.A) (r : P.B a → FreeM P α) :
    SomeOutput p (FreeM.liftBind a r) ↔ ∃ b, SomeOutput p (r b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hpc⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_support_liftBind.mp hc
    exact ⟨b, c, hb, hpc⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, c, hc, hpc⟩
    exact ⟨c, mem_support_liftBind.mpr ⟨b, hc⟩, hpc⟩

name: noOutput_liftBind
statement:
@[freeM_unfold]
theorem noOutput_liftBind (p : α → Prop) (a : P.A) (r : P.B a → FreeM P α) :
    NoOutput p (FreeM.liftBind a r) ↔ ∀ b, NoOutput p (r b)
proof:
:=
  allOutputs_liftBind (fun a => ¬ p a) a r

name: support_eq_range_output
statement:
theorem support_eq_range_output (s : FreeM P α) :
    support s = Set.range (FreeM.output s)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | pure x =>
      ext c
      simp only [support_pure', Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_range]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨⟩, h.symm⟩, fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h.symm⟩
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
      change support (FreeM.liftBind a r) =
        Set.range (FreeM.output (FreeM.liftBind a r))
      rw [support_liftBind]
      ext c
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
        rw [ih b, Set.mem_range] at hb
        obtain ⟨path, hpath⟩ := hb
        exact ⟨⟨b, path⟩, hpath⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨b, path⟩, hpath⟩
        refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
        rw [ih b]
        exact ⟨path, hpath⟩

name: support_eq_liftM_univ
statement:
theorem support_eq_liftM_univ {γ : Type uB} (x : FreeM P γ) :
    support x = SetM.run (x.liftM (fun _ => (Set.univ : SetM _)))
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op r ih =>
      change (⋃ b, supp (r b)) = SetM.run (_ >>= _)
      change _ = ⋃ b ∈ (Set.univ : Set (P.B op)), SetM.run ((r b).liftM _)
      simp only [Set.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true]
      exact iSup_congr ih

name: map_liftBind
statement:
theorem map_liftBind {X : Type uβ} {Y : Type uγ} (f : X → Y)

name: bind_map_right
statement:
theorem bind_map_right {δ : Type uδ} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    (mx : FreeM P δ) (g : δ → FreeM P β) (f : β → γ) :
    FreeM.bind mx (fun x => FreeM.map f (g x)) =
      FreeM.map f (FreeM.bind mx g)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [FreeM.bind_pure_comp] using
    (FreeM.bind_assoc mx g (pure ∘ f)).symm

statement:

theorem mapLens_liftBind (l : Lens P Q) (a : P.A) (rest : P.B a → FreeM P α) :

      FreeM.liftBind (l.toFunA a) (fun d ↦ (rest (l.toFunB a d)).mapLens l)

name: mapLens_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLens_id (x : FreeM P α) :
    x.mapLens (Lens.id P) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind a rest ih => exact congrArg (FreeM.liftBind a) (funext ih)

name: mapLens_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLens_comp (l₂ : Lens Q R) (l₁ : Lens P Q) (x : FreeM P α) :
    (x.mapLens l₁).mapLens l₂ = x.mapLens (l₂ ∘ₗ l₁)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind a rest ih =>
      exact congrArg (FreeM.liftBind (l₂.toFunA (l₁.toFunA a))) (funext fun d => ih _)

name: mapLens_bind
statement:
theorem mapLens_bind (l : Lens P Q) (x : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β) :
    (FreeM.bind x f).mapLens l =
      FreeM.bind (x.mapLens l) (fun a => (f a).mapLens l)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind a rest ih => exact congrArg (FreeM.liftBind (l.toFunA a)) (funext fun d => ih _)

name: mapLens_bind'
statement:

theorem mapLens_bind' (l : Lens P Q) (x : FreeM P α) (f : α → FreeM P β) :

name: liftMHom_toFun_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftMHom_toFun_eq (s : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) :
    ((FreeM.liftMHom s).toFun α) = fun x => x.liftM s

name: liftMHom'_toFun_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftMHom'_toFun_eq (s : NatHom P.Obj m) :
    (FreeM.liftMHom' s).toFun α = fun x => x.liftM (fun t => s ⟨t, id⟩)

name: liftMHom_unique
statement:
theorem liftMHom_unique (F : FreeM P →ᵐ m) (h : ∀ a, F (FreeM.lift a) = s a) :
    F = FreeM.liftMHom s
proof:
:= by
  refine MonadHom.ext' fun β x => ?_
  induction x with
  | pure x => exact F.mmap_pure x
  | lift_bind a r ih =>
    change F (FreeM.liftBind a r) = FreeM.liftM s (FreeM.liftBind a r)
    rw [show (FreeM.liftBind a r : FreeM P β) = FreeM.lift a >>= r from rfl,
      MonadHom.mmap_bind, h, FreeM.liftM_lift_bind]
    exact bind_congr ih

name: liftM_natural
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftM_natural (φ : m →ᵐ n) (x : FreeM P α) :
    φ (FreeM.liftM s x) = FreeM.liftM (fun a => φ (s a)) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure x => exact φ.mmap_pure x
  | lift_bind a r ih => simp [ih]

name: liftMHom_comp
statement:
theorem liftMHom_comp (φ : m →ᵐ n) :
    φ ∘ₘ FreeM.liftMHom s = FreeM.liftMHom (fun a => φ (s a))
proof:
:=
  MonadHom.ext' fun β x => by simp

name: run_liftM_mapHom
statement:
theorem run_liftM_mapHom (φ : m →ᵐ n) (impl : (a : P.A) → StateT σ m (P.B a))
    (x : FreeM P α) (s : σ) :
    (FreeM.liftM (fun a => StateT.mapHom φ (impl a)) x).run s =
      φ ((FreeM.liftM impl x).run s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← liftM_natural impl (StateT.mapHom φ) x, StateT.run_mapHom]

name: liftM_lift_eq_self
statement: @[simp] theorem liftM_lift_eq_self (x : FreeM P α) : FreeM.liftM FreeM.lift x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure y => rfl
  | lift_bind a r ih => simp [ih]

name: liftMHom_lift_eq_id
statement:
theorem liftMHom_lift_eq_id :
    FreeM.liftMHom (P := P) (m := FreeM P) FreeM.lift = MonadHom.id (FreeM P)

name: liftM_comp
statement:
theorem liftM_comp {Q : PFunctor.{uA₂, uB}} {m : Type uB → Type v}
    [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (x : FreeM P α)
    (first : (a : P.A) → FreeM Q (P.B a))
    (second : (a : Q.A) → m (Q.B a)) :
    (x.liftM first).liftM second =
      x.liftM (fun a => (first a).liftM second)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind a rest ih =>
      change
        ((first a >>= fun b => (rest b).liftM first).liftM second) =
          (first a).liftM second >>= fun b =>
            (rest b).liftM (fun a => (first a).liftM second)
      rw [FreeM.liftM_bind]
      exact congrArg (fun k => (first a).liftM second >>= k) (funext ih)

statement:

theorem replicate_zero (a : α) (s : FreeM P α) :

name: replicate_succ
statement:

theorem replicate_succ (a : α) (s : FreeM P α) (n : Nat) :

name: replicate_zero
statement:

theorem replicate_zero {Γ : P.A → Type w₂} (a : α) {s : FreeM P α} (d : Decoration Γ s) :
    Decoration.replicate a d 0 = (⟨⟩ : Decoration Γ (FreeM.replicate a s 0))

name: replicate_succ
statement:

theorem replicate_succ {Γ : P.A → Type w₂} (a : α) {s : FreeM P α} (d : Decoration Γ s)
    (n : Nat) :
    Decoration.replicate a d (n + 1) =
      Decoration.append d (fun _ => Decoration.replicate a d n)

name: replicate_zero
statement:
@[simp, freeM_unfold]
theorem replicate_zero {Γ : P.A → Type w₂} {F : (a : P.A) → Γ a → Type w₃}
    (a : α) {s : FreeM P α} {d : Decoration Γ s} (r : Decoration.Over Γ F s d) :
    Decoration.Over.replicate a r 0 =
      (⟨⟩ : Decoration.Over Γ F (FreeM.replicate a s 0) (d.replicate a 0))

name: replicate_succ
statement:
@[simp, freeM_unfold]
theorem replicate_succ {Γ : P.A → Type w₂} {F : (a : P.A) → Γ a → Type w₃}
    (a : α) {s : FreeM P α} {d : Decoration Γ s} (r : Decoration.Over Γ F s d) (n : Nat) :
    Decoration.Over.replicate a r (n + 1) =
      Decoration.Over.append r (fun _ => Over.replicate a r n)

name: map_replicate
statement:
theorem map_replicate {Γ : P.A → Type w₂} {F : (a : P.A) → Γ a → Type w₃}
    {G : (a : P.A) → Γ a → Type w₄} (η : ∀ a γ, F a γ → G a γ) (a : α)
    {s : FreeM P α} {d : Decoration Γ s} (r : Decoration.Over Γ F s d) (n : Nat) :
    Decoration.Over.map η (FreeM.replicate a s n) (d.replicate a n)
        (Decoration.Over.replicate a r n) =
      Decoration.Over.replicate a (Decoration.Over.map η s d r) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [Decoration.Over.map_append, ih]

  induction spine with
  | root => rfl
  | down answer tail ih =>
      change _ :: Path.trace _ (tail.plug path) =

      rw [ih]

name: length_eq
statement:
theorem length_eq (extension : Extends earlier later) :
    later.length = earlier.length + extension.continuation.length
proof:
:=
  calc
    later.length = (earlier.comp extension.continuation).length :=
      congrArg length extension.comp_eq.symm
    _ = earlier.length + extension.continuation.length :=
      length_comp earlier extension.continuation

name: length_le
statement:
theorem length_le (extension : Extends earlier later) :
    earlier.length ≤ later.length

name: trace_eq
statement:
theorem trace_eq (extension : Extends earlier later) :
    later.trace = List.append earlier.trace extension.continuation.trace
proof:
:=
  calc
    later.trace = (earlier.comp extension.continuation).trace :=
      congrArg Cursor.trace extension.comp_eq.symm
    _ = List.append earlier.trace extension.continuation.trace :=
      trace_comp earlier extension.continuation

name: length_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem length_eq_add_one (extension : ExtendsByOne earlier later) :
    later.length = earlier.length + 1
proof:
:=
  calc
    later.length = (earlier.comp extension.edge.toCursor).length :=
      congrArg length extension.comp_eq.symm
    _ = earlier.length + extension.edge.toCursor.length :=
      length_comp earlier extension.edge.toCursor
    _ = earlier.length + 1 := by rw [Edge.length_toCursor]

name: residual_ofPath
statement:

theorem residual_ofPath : (program : FreeM P α) → (path : Path program) →
    (ofPath program path).residual = FreeM.pure (output program path)
  | .pure _, _ => rfl
  | .liftBind _ next, ⟨answer, tail⟩ => residual_ofPath (next answer) tail

name: ofPath_plug
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_plug (cursor : Cursor program) (path : Path cursor.residual) :
    ofPath program (cursor.plug path) = cursor.comp (ofPath cursor.residual path)
proof:
:= by
  cases cursor with
  | mk residual spine =>
      induction spine with
      | root => rfl
      | down answer tail ih =>
          change down answer (ofPath _ (tail.plug path)) =
            down answer ((⟨_, tail⟩ : Cursor _).comp (ofPath _ path))
          simpa [plug, comp] using congrArg (down answer) (ih path)

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {left right : Terminal program}
    (cursor_eq : left.cursor = right.cursor)
    (output_eq : left.output = right.output) : left = right
proof:
:= by
  cases left with
  | mk leftCursor leftOutput leftResidual =>
      cases right with
      | mk rightCursor rightOutput rightResidual =>
          cases cursor_eq
          cases output_eq
          have residual_eq : leftResidual = rightResidual := Subsingleton.elim _ _
          cases residual_eq
          rfl

name: isTerminal
statement: theorem isTerminal (terminal : Terminal program) : terminal.cursor.IsTerminal

name: ofPath_residualPath
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_residualPath (terminal : Terminal program) :
    ofPath terminal.cursor.residual terminal.residualPath = root terminal.cursor.residual
proof:
:= by
  cases terminal with
  | mk cursor leaf residual_eq =>
      cases cursor with
      | mk residual spine =>
          dsimp at residual_eq ⊢
          subst residual
          rfl

name: isTerminal_iff_exists_terminal
statement:
theorem isTerminal_iff_exists_terminal (cursor : Cursor program) :
    cursor.IsTerminal ↔
      ∃ terminal : Terminal program, terminal.cursor = cursor
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨output, residual_eq⟩
    exact ⟨⟨cursor, output, residual_eq⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨terminal, rfl⟩
    exact terminal.isTerminal

name: terminalOfPath_cursor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem terminalOfPath_cursor : (program : FreeM P α) → (path : Path program) →
    (terminalOfPath program path).cursor = ofPath program path
  | .pure _, _ => rfl
  | .liftBind _ next, ⟨answer, tail⟩ => by
      change down answer (terminalOfPath (next answer) tail).cursor =
        down answer (ofPath (next answer) tail)
      rw [terminalOfPath_cursor]

@[simp]

name: terminalOfPath_output
statement:
@[simp]
theorem terminalOfPath_output : (program : FreeM P α) → (path : Path program) →
    (terminalOfPath program path).output = output program path
  | .pure _, _ => rfl
  | .liftBind _ next, ⟨answer, tail⟩ => terminalOfPath_output (next answer) tail

@[simp]

name: pathOfTerminal_terminalOfPath
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathOfTerminal_terminalOfPath :
    (program : FreeM P α) → (path : Path program) →
      pathOfTerminal (terminalOfPath program path) = path
  | .pure _, _ => rfl
  | .liftBind a next, ⟨answer, tail⟩ => by
      change (⟨answer, pathOfTerminal (terminalOfPath (next answer) tail)⟩ :
        Path (FreeM.liftBind a next)) = ⟨answer, tail⟩
      rw [pathOfTerminal_terminalOfPath]

name: terminal_output_eq_path_output
statement:
theorem terminal_output_eq_path_output (terminal : Terminal program) :
    terminal.output = output program (pathOfTerminal terminal)
proof:
:= by
  change terminal.output = output program (terminal.cursor.plug terminal.residualPath)
  rw [output_plug]
  cases terminal with
  | mk cursor leaf residual_eq =>
      cases cursor with
      | mk residual spine =>
          dsimp at residual_eq ⊢
          subst residual
          rfl

name: terminalOfPath_pathOfTerminal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem terminalOfPath_pathOfTerminal :
    (terminal : Terminal program) →
      terminalOfPath program (pathOfTerminal terminal) = terminal
proof:
:= by
  intro terminal
  have cursor_eq :
      (terminalOfPath program (pathOfTerminal terminal)).cursor = terminal.cursor := by
    rw [terminalOfPath_cursor]
    change ofPath program (terminal.cursor.plug terminal.residualPath) = terminal.cursor
    rw [ofPath_plug, Terminal.ofPath_residualPath, comp_root]
  have output_eq :
      (terminalOfPath program (pathOfTerminal terminal)).output = terminal.output := by
    rw [terminalOfPath_output]
    exact (terminal_output_eq_path_output terminal).symm
  exact Terminal.ext cursor_eq output_eq

/-! ## Runtime paths and lens-mapped trees -/

/
View a runtime path through `s` along `l` as the canonical path through the
lens-mapped runtime tree `s.mapLens l`.

The two types have the same constructor shape, but `PathAlong` is defined over
the source tree while `Path (s.mapLens l)` is defined over the lens-mapped tree.
-/
def pathAlongToMapLensPath (l : Lens P Q) :
    (s : FreeM P α) → PathAlong l s → Path (s.mapLens l)
  | .pure _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .liftBind a rest, ⟨d, path⟩ =>
      ⟨d, pathAlongToMapLensPath l (rest (l.toFunB a d)) path⟩

/
canonical path through the source tree. -/
def Path.pullMapLens (l : Lens P Q) :
    (s : FreeM P α) → Path (s.mapLens l) → Path s
  | .pure _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .liftBind a rest, ⟨d, path⟩ =>
      ⟨l.toFunB a d, pullMapLens l (rest (l.toFunB a d)) path⟩

@[simp]

name: Path.pullMapLens_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.pullMapLens_pure (l : Lens P Q) (x : α)
    (path : Path ((FreeM.pure x : FreeM P α).mapLens l)) :
    Path.pullMapLens l (pure x) path = ⟨⟩

name: Path.pullMapLens_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.pullMapLens_lift_bind (l : Lens P Q) (a : P.A)
    (rest : P.B a → FreeM P α) (d : Q.B (l.toFunA a))
    (path : Path ((rest (l.toFunB a d)).mapLens l)) :
    Path.pullMapLens l ((FreeM.lift a).bind rest) ⟨d, path⟩ =
      ⟨l.toFunB a d, Path.pullMapLens l (rest (l.toFunB a d)) path⟩

name: Path.pullMapLens_eq_projectPathAlong
statement:
theorem Path.pullMapLens_eq_projectPathAlong (l : Lens P Q) :
    (s : FreeM P α) → (path : Path (s.mapLens l)) →
    Path.pullMapLens l s path =
      projectPathAlong l s (mapLensPathToPathAlong l s path)
  | .pure _, _ => rfl
  | .liftBind a rest, ⟨d, path⟩ =>
      congrArg (fun tail : Path (rest (l.toFunB a d)) =>
        (⟨l.toFunB a d, tail⟩ : Path (FreeM.liftBind a rest)))
        (pullMapLens_eq_projectPathAlong l (rest (l.toFunB a d)) path)

Relabelling changes no operation-node directions. -/
def Path.pullMap {β : Type t} (f : α → β) :
    (s : FreeM P α) → Path (s.map f) → Path s
  | .pure _, _ => ⟨⟩
  | .liftBind _a rest, ⟨b, path⟩ =>
      ⟨b, pullMap f (rest b) path⟩
